name: Publish fa_llm

on:
  push:
    tags: ['fa_llm-v*']

# Cancel superseded runs of the same ref (issue #177).
concurrency:
  group: Publish fa_llm-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC — pub.dev verifies the GitHub identity, no secrets
  contents: read

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: packages/fa_llm
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@6afc89df92d6eb3834022f73cd65adc8cdfcb92d # v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - run: dart pub get

      - name: Publish to pub.dev
        run: dart pub publish --force

# Daily auto-publish (issue #161): thin orchestrator over the existing
# publish channels. Each channel is an isolated leg — one leg failing never
# kills the others — and every failure self-files a deduplicated GitHub
# issue (label `bug`, assigned to the owner) that auto-closes when the leg
# goes green again. No publish logic is duplicated here: legs dispatch the
# existing workflows via `gh workflow run` and watch them.
#
#   testflight  build-mobile.yml   ios_content=all (the iOS half of the
#                                 mobile build)
#   play        build-mobile.yml   android_content=all,
#                                 android_track=beta (Android external
#                                 beta / open testing — issue #289 lifts
#                                 the standing "Android excluded" owner
#                                 decision for the release track; #947
#                                 adds the listing deploy — texts +
#                                 whole-set image replace + verify — so
#                                 the listing never trails the goldens;
#                                 the leg green-skips while the Play
#                                 secrets are absent)
#   pubdev      in-job OIDC publish, only when pubspec > pub.dev; otherwise
#               a green up-to-date check. The tag-time OIDC publish job
#               (ci.yml) stays the primary path; this leg is the catch-up +
#               loud-failure detector (e.g. expired publish credentials)
#   cli         build-macos.yml    desktop DMG + macOS CLI bundles +
#                                 extension, attached to the next-tag
#                                 release (version passed explicitly so
#                                 mobile/desktop never mint diverging tags)
#   website     pages.yml          fa1.dev (landing + web demo + extension
#                                 + the /outlook add-in slice)
#   addin       office-addin.yml   manifest/taskpane acceptance suite; the
#                                 fa1.dev publish itself rides the website
#                                 leg (pages.yml assembles /outlook)
#
# Legs run only when main moved since the last GREEN daily run — skip-no-
# change is green-neutral, never red (#159 lesson). One exception (gh-1192):
# while main's pubspec version is not yet served by pub.dev the plan gate
# (scripts/daily_plan.sh) forces the legs anyway — a release-in-flight
# green must not become a skip baseline that stalls re-verification and
# rerun-recovery on a quiet main. Versioning stays the
# existing scheme: auto_release.sh patch-bumps + tags every main push
# (2h coalesce); the daily attaches mobile/desktop artifacts to the next
# tag and verifies/republishes pub.dev. See docs/ci.md.
#
# Pause: gh workflow disable daily-publish.yml -R IstiN/flutter_agent_harness

name: Daily auto-publish

run-name: "Daily auto-publish (${{ inputs.legs || 'all' }})"

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 5 * * *' # once daily, 05:17 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      legs:
        description: 'Leg(s) to run'
        type: choice
        default: all
        options:
          - all
          - testflight
          - play
          - pubdev
          - cli
          - website
          - addin
      force:
        description: 'Run even if main has not moved since the last green daily'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      inject_failure:
        description: 'TEST ONLY — fail this leg before any dispatch, to exercise the self-filing issue cycle'
        type: choice
        default: none
        options:
          - none
          - testflight
          - play
          - pubdev
          - cli
          - website
          - addin

permissions:
  contents: read

# One daily at a time; a queued run must not cancel an in-flight one.
concurrency:
  group: daily-publish
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  plan:
    name: Plan (change detection + versions)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # gh-1477: 10m was the same time bomb as the derive-version jobs — a
    # full-history fetch under a 10m ceiling. 20m + the blobless filter
    # below.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    outputs:
      changed: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.changed }}
      next_tag: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.next_tag }}
      latest_tag: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.latest_tag }}
      pubspec_version: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.pubspec_version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1477: daily_plan.sh reads tags / commit metadata / one file
          # at origin/main — never historical blobs. Blobless keeps full
          # tag/commit metadata without the blobs (the full fetch outgrew
          # the old 10m ceiling in the twin derive-version job, run
          # 38027695551).
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Detect main movement and derive versions
        id: plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          FORCE: ${{ inputs.force }}
        # gh-1192: the gate (baseline + the release-unresolved re-arm that
        # keeps AC1's «the next daily re-verifies» true on a quiet main)
        # lives in the extracted script — shell-harness tested by
        # test/release_flow_race_test.dart.
        run: bash scripts/daily_plan.sh

  # ── Dispatch legs ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Shape per leg: dispatch the child workflow pinned to main, capture the
  # new run id, watch it, fail on any non-success conclusion. The child run
  # URL is exported even on failure so the report can excerpt its log.
  #
  # ── Timeout arithmetic (#351) ────────────────────────────────────────────
  # Invariants: watch budget > child worst-case (a legitimate slow child is
  # NEVER cancelled by the watcher — that was the #351 bug), leg
  # timeout > budget (the watcher, including its one cancel + re-dispatch
  # cycle, always outlives the child), and where the math fits under
  # GitHub's 360m job cap, leg timeout ≥ 2×budget + ~15m so the SECOND
  # wedge's fail-fast can actually fire inside the leg.
  #
  # Child worst-case = sum of the serialized job timeout-minutes along the
  # child's critical path (every job in a watched chain carries an explicit
  # timeout for exactly this). Margin = appear window (60×10s) + cancel
  # wait (180s) + poll slack ≈ 15m.
  #
  #   leg        child worst-case (serialized chain)          budget    leg timeout
  #   testflight version 20 → build-ios 90 → submit-ios 120   230m  →  250m (15000s) ; 360m
  #             (∥ release-mobile 15, covered by the max)
  #   play       version 20 → build-android 45 →              95m   →  110m (6600s) ; 240m
  #             submit-android 30 (∥ release-mobile 15)
  #   cli        version 20 → build-macos 150×2 (arm64 +      335m  →  350m (21000s) ; 360m
  #             x86_64 SERIALIZE on the single self-hosted
  #             runner) → release-macos 15
  #             (∥ cli matrix 45, extension 30 — shorter paths)
  #   (gh-1477: the version/plan jobs' ceiling moved 10 → 20m — a
  #   full-history fetch outgrew the 10m bomb; the fetch is now blobless
  #   and 20m is the seatbelt. Worst-cases and budgets grew by exactly
  #   the +10m.)
  #   website    pages build 45 → deploy 15                   60m   →   75m (4500s)  ; 180m
  #   addin      office-addin-suite 45 (single job)           45m   →   60m (3600s)  ; 150m
  #
  # Second-wedge headroom (2×budget + ~15m vs leg timeout): play 235 ≤
  # 240 ✓, website 163 ≤ 180 ✓, addin 133 ≤ 150 ✓. testflight (515 > 360)
  # and cli (715 > 360) CANNOT fit two full budgets under GitHub's 360m
  # job cap — their first wedge still self-heals (cancel at budget +
  # re-dispatch ≈ budget+13m), and a second wedge is bounded by the leg
  # timeout instead of the watcher's fail-fast; both children carry
  # per-job server-side timeouts (#344) so a wedged job self-fails even
  # without the watcher.

  testflight:
    name: 'Leg: TestFlight'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 230m (version 20 + build-ios 90 +
    # submit-ios 120) → budget 250m; 360m leg > budget. Two full budgets
    # (515m) exceed GitHub's 360m cap — a second wedge is bounded by this
    # leg timeout, not the watcher fail-fast.
    timeout-minutes: 360
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'testflight')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'testflight'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=testflight) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      - name: Dispatch build-mobile.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Shared watcher (issues #343/#344): correlates OUR run by the
          # child's run-name ("build-mobile (none/all)" — displayTitle is
          # the only distinguisher in the run-list API), newest match in a
          # tight window; a wedged run (self-hosted slot lost, #344) is
          # cancelled and re-dispatched once before failing.
          # Budget 250m = child worst-case 230m (version 20 + build-ios 90
          # + submit-ios 120, #351; gh-1477 moved the version ceiling
          # 10 → 20m — blobless fetch + seatbelt) + 20m margin — a healthy
          # slow TestFlight
          # submit (Apple processing can legitimately take the full 90m
          # ASC wait + 15m verify) is never cancelled by the watcher.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh build-mobile.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-mobile (none/all)' \
            --budget-seconds 15000 \
            -f android_content=none -f ios_content=all \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  play:
    name: 'Leg: Play (Android external beta)'
    # Independent of the testflight leg (#359). The #348 serialization was
    # a mitigation for the #343 sibling-dispatch race; #351 eliminated that
    # race structurally — exact displayTitle correlation (this leg's child
    # runs as "build-mobile (all/none)", the testflight leg's as
    # "(none/all)"), NEWEST match, a tight 30s window, and build-mobile's
    # per-run_id concurrency group (no dispatch can cancel another). With
    # the race gone the needs-edge only bought harm: a cancelled testflight
    # watcher skipped Play behind it and the edge added up to 360m of start
    # latency (one leg's external blocker stopped the train — run
    # 34827074052, BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL user-owned).
    #
    # The two residual #346 concerns are handled structurally, not by
    # ordering:
    #   * same-tag convergence — both children independently derive
    #     latest-tag+1, so they can attach to ONE release concurrently;
    #     release_attach_or_create.sh is race-idempotent (a lost create
    #     uploads into the winner's release) with an ownership-scoped draft
    #     guard, and the asset sets never collide (AAB vs IPA).
    #   * runner contention — none: the Android chain is all GitHub-hosted
    #     runners; only build-ios touches the single self-hosted macOS
    #     runner (which already serializes physically with the cli leg's
    #     build-macos children — that pair has always been independent).
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic (unchanged by #359 — only the leg's START moved):
    # child wc 95m (version 20 + build-android 45 + submit-android 30) →
    # budget 110m; 240m leg ≥ 2×budget + 15m, so the second-wedge
    # fail-fast fits inside the leg.
    timeout-minutes: 240
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'play')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      # Secrets presence is checked in the first step — while the Play
      # upload keystore/service account are not configured, the leg green-
      # skips with a notice (existing neutral-skip leg semantics); it goes
      # live the moment the owner sets them (issue #289).
      PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
      ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
      ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
      ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
      ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'play'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=play) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      - name: Skip without Play secrets (green-neutral)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          missing=""
          [ -z "${ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64:-}" ] && missing="$missing ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64"
          [ -z "${ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD:-}" ] && missing="$missing ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD"
          [ -z "${ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS:-}" ] && missing="$missing ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS"
          [ -z "${ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD:-}" ] && missing="$missing ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD"
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            missing="$missing PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON"
          fi
          if [ -n "$missing" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play secrets not configured (missing:${missing}) — the Android leg skips green-neutrally until the upload keystore + Play service account secrets exist (issue #289 owner checklist)."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "All Play secrets present — dispatching the Android build+upload."

      - name: Dispatch build-mobile.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # all: build + Play upload + LISTING deploy (issue #947) — the
          # listing lane replaces the whole image set per locale + device
          # type and verifies it via edits.images.list, so the listing can
          # never trail the committed goldens by more than one train.
          # beta = the external/open testing track, mirroring the iOS leg's
          # external TestFlight group (#239 pattern).
          # Shared watcher (issues #343/#344). Since #359 the TestFlight
          # sibling leg fires CONCURRENTLY with this one (both needs: plan)
          # and dispatches the SAME workflow in the same minute —
          # correlation is by the child's run-name ("build-mobile
          # (all/none)" vs the sibling's "(none/all)", pinned by
          # test), never by "first run in the window", with newest-match +
          # the 30s window; a wedged run is cancelled and re-dispatched
          # once (with the same distinct inputs → same distinct title).
          # Budget 110m = child worst-case 95m (#351: version 20 +
          # build-android 45 + submit-android 30; the #947 listing
          # deploy rides the submit-android job's slack; gh-1477 moved
          # the version ceiling 10 → 20m) + 15m margin.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh build-mobile.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-mobile (all/none)' \
            --budget-seconds 6600 \
            -f android_content=all -f android_track=beta -f ios_content=none \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  cli:
    name: 'Leg: CLI + macOS desktop'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 335m (version 20 + build-macos 150×2 — the
    # arm64 AND x86_64 matrix legs SERIALIZE on the single self-hosted
    # macOS runner — + release-macos 15) → budget 350m; 360m leg > budget.
    # Two full budgets (715m) far exceed GitHub's 360m cap — a second
    # wedge is bounded by this leg timeout, not the watcher fail-fast
    # (both build-macos jobs carry 150m server-side timeouts, #344).
    timeout-minutes: 360
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'cli')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'cli'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=cli) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      - name: Dispatch build-macos.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Children derive version themselves (latest tag + 1 at their own
          # dispatch moment) — a tag pinned here would race auto_release and
          # could attach assets to a tag pointing at a different commit.
          # Shared watcher (issues #343/#344): correlates OUR run by the
          # child's run-name ("build-macos (create_release=true)") so a
          # concurrent human dispatch is never adopted; a wedged self-hosted
          # run is cancelled and re-dispatched once. Budget 350m = child
          # worst-case 335m (#351: version 20 + build-macos 150 ×2 arches
          # serialized on the one self-hosted runner + release-macos 15;
          # gh-1477 moved the version ceiling 10 → 20m)
          # + 15m margin.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh build-macos.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --title 'build-macos (create_release=true)' \
            --budget-seconds 21000 \
            -f create_release=true \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  website:
    name: 'Leg: Website'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 60m (pages build 45 + deploy 15) → budget
    # 75m; 180m leg ≥ 2×budget + 15m, so the second-wedge fail-fast fits
    # (the old 45m leg made the self-heal dead code: 40m budget + 10m
    # appear window never completed inside it).
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'website')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'website'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=website) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      # pages.yml is path-filtered on push, so routine pushes (e.g. lib/
      # changes outside its filters) never redeploy — the daily guarantees
      # fa1.dev tracks main.
      - name: Dispatch pages.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Shared watcher (issues #343/#344). pages.yml takes no inputs, so
          # there is no displayTitle to disambiguate on — the watcher falls
          # back to newest-in-tight-window, and still bounds the watch
          # (cancel + one re-dispatch) instead of blocking forever.
          # Budget 75m = child worst-case 60m (#351: pages build 45 +
          # deploy 15) + 15m margin.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh pages.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --budget-seconds 4500 \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  addin:
    name: 'Leg: Outlook add-in'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # #351 arithmetic: child wc 45m (single office-addin-suite job) →
    # budget 60m; 150m leg ≥ 2×budget + 15m, so the second-wedge fail-fast
    # fits (the old 45m leg made the self-heal dead code).
    timeout-minutes: 150
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'addin')
    outputs:
      run_url: ${{ steps.dispatch.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'addin'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=addin) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing dispatched"
          exit 1

      # Acceptance suite (manifest validation, dart2js taskpane, Node +
      # Playwright e2e). The fa1.dev /outlook publish itself rides the
      # website leg — pages.yml assembles the same add-in into the deploy.
      - name: Dispatch office-addin.yml and watch
        id: dispatch
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Shared watcher (issues #343/#344). No inputs to disambiguate on
          # (newest-in-tight-window fallback), watch bounded at 60m =
          # child worst-case 45m (#351) + 15m margin.
          rc=0
          bash scripts/dispatch_and_watch.sh office-addin.yml \
            --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --ref main \
            --budget-seconds 3600 \
            --out-run-id run_id.txt || rc=$?
          if [ -s run_id.txt ]; then
            echo "run_url=https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/$(cat run_id.txt)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
          exit "$rc"

  # ── pub.dev leg ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  # The ONLY publish path is the ci.yml tag job (pub.dev trusted publishing
  # only accepts OIDC from tag-push runs — a schedule/dispatch run can never
  # satisfy it). This leg VERIFIES pub.dev serves the pubspec version and,
  # when behind, recovers by re-running the failed tag-push publish run —
  # a rerun keeps the original push-tag event and OIDC claims, so the real
  # publish path retries. Unrecoverable states fail loudly and self-file an
  # issue with a manual-publish instruction instead of silently hanging.
  # gh-1192: a tag-publish still EXECUTING (tag pushed, ci run not visible
  # yet or queued/in_progress, tag younger than the grace window; or the
  # release-tag job has not cut the tag off a fresh bump yet) is classified
  # «release in flight» by scripts/verify_pubdev_release.sh — a neutral skip
  # (no error, no auto-filed issue); the next scheduled daily re-verifies.
  # The 2026-10-03 collision fired the old «no ci.yml run» error one minute
  # before the healthy run completed (#1189, false alarm).

  pubdev:
    name: 'Leg: pub.dev'
    needs: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: write # gh run rerun of the tag-publish run
    if: >-
      (needs.plan.outputs.changed == 'true' || inputs.force == true) &&
      (inputs.legs == '' || inputs.legs == 'all' || inputs.legs == 'pubdev')
    outputs:
      status: ${{ steps.check.outputs.status }}
      pubspec_version: ${{ steps.check.outputs.pubspec }}
      published_version: ${{ steps.check.outputs.published }}
      run_url: ${{ steps.check.outputs.run_url }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Inject failure (test)
        if: inputs.inject_failure == 'pubdev'
        run: |
          echo "::error::injected failure (inject_failure=pubdev) — exercising the self-filing issue path, nothing published"
          exit 1

      - name: Verify pub.dev serves the pubspec version
        id: check
        # gh-1192: the classification (up-to-date / release-in-flight /
        # recovered + the unchanged alarms) lives in the extracted script so
        # it is shell-harness testable (test/release_flow_race_test.dart).
        run: bash scripts/verify_pubdev_release.sh

  # ── Release-draft sweeper (issue #282) ────────────────────────────────────
  # Hygiene leg: no pipeline step may leave a draft release behind (the
  # 3-week-old v0.1.190 rot). The per-job guards in build-macos/build-mobile
  # own the failure path; this sweeper is the daily backstop — anything that
  # slips through (a cancelled run, a path without a guard) is deleted after
  # 24h and a deduplicated self-closing issue names the creating run so a
  # RECURRING stuck draft points at its broken step instead of rotting.
  # Runs on every daily (and manual) invocation regardless of leg results —
  # change-gating must not gate hygiene.
  sweep-drafts:
    name: Sweep stale release drafts
    needs: plan
    if: always() # even when plan failed or all legs skipped
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write # delete draft releases
      actions: read # name each swept draft's creating run (gh run list 403s without it, review of #294)
      issues: write # deduplicated self-closing sweep issue
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Delete drafts older than 24h and file the dedup issue
        run: bash scripts/sweep_stale_drafts.sh

  # ── Report + self-healing issues ─────────────────────────────────────────
  report:
    name: Summary + self-filed issues
    needs: [plan, testflight, play, pubdev, cli, website, addin]
    if: always() # runs even when plan failed, so plan failures enter the self-healing loop too
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      issues: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Job summary table and issue lifecycle
        env:
          NEXT_TAG: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.next_tag }}
          PLAN_RESULT: ${{ needs.plan.result }}
          DAILY_PUBLISH_ASSIGNEE: ai-teammate
          LEG_TESTFLIGHT: ${{ needs.testflight.result }}
          LEG_TESTFLIGHT_URL: ${{ needs.testflight.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_PLAY: ${{ needs.play.result }}
          LEG_PLAY_URL: ${{ needs.play.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_PUBDEV: ${{ needs.pubdev.result }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_STATUS: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.status }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_PUBSPEC: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.pubspec_version }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_PUBLISHED: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.published_version }}
          LEG_PUBDEV_URL: ${{ needs.pubdev.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_CLI: ${{ needs.cli.result }}
          LEG_CLI_URL: ${{ needs.cli.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_WEBSITE: ${{ needs.website.result }}
          LEG_WEBSITE_URL: ${{ needs.website.outputs.run_url }}
          LEG_ADDIN: ${{ needs.addin.result }}
          LEG_ADDIN_URL: ${{ needs.addin.outputs.run_url }}
        run: bash scripts/daily_publish_report.sh

      # gh-1478: the inject_failure TEST hook must prove the filed digest
      # QUOTES the injected ::error:: line (signal-first excerpt via the
      # per-job log endpoint), not merely that an issue exists — the #1473
      # tree-noise regression class.
      # The `!= ''` guard matters: on schedule triggers the `inputs` context
      # is EMPTY (the dispatch `default: none` does not apply), so gating
      # only on `!= 'none'` would run — and fail — this step every cron run.
      - name: Verify injected-failure excerpt (TEST)
        if: always() && inputs.inject_failure != '' && inputs.inject_failure != 'none'
        env:
          INJECTED: ${{ inputs.inject_failure }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          title="[daily-publish] ${INJECTED} leg failed"
          n=$(gh issue list --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --state open \
                --label daily-publish --limit 200 \
                --json number,title --jq '.[] | [.number, .title] | @tsv' \
                | while IFS=$'\t' read -r num t; do
                    [ "$t" = "$title" ] && echo "$num"
                  done | head -1)
          if [ -z "$n" ]; then
            echo "::error::inject_failure verify: no open issue titled '${title}' — the self-filing path regressed"
            exit 1
          fi
          text=$(gh issue view "$n" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
                   --json body,comments --jq '.body, (.comments[]?.body // empty)')
          if ! grep -qF "injected failure (inject_failure=${INJECTED})" <<< "$text"; then
            echo "::error::inject_failure verify: issue #${n} never quotes the injected ::error:: line — the signal-first excerpt regressed (gh-1478)"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "inject_failure verify OK: issue #${n} quotes the injected error line (gh-1478)"

name: Build Mobile Apps

# Issue #343: the daily-publish TestFlight and Play legs dispatch this
# workflow in the same minute with different content inputs; the run-name
# embeds those inputs so `gh run list` displayTitle (the ONLY distinguisher
# the list API offers) tells the legs apart — each watcher matches its own
# run instead of latching a sibling's or a stale same-shaped one.
run-name: "build-mobile (${{ inputs.android_content }}/${{ inputs.ios_content }})"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g. v0.1.0) or "auto" to increment patch'
        required: false
        default: 'auto'
      android_content:
        description: 'Android: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip Android entirely
          - all              # build + upload + metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only (no build, no upload, no screenshots)
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only (no build, no upload, no texts)
          - app_only         # build + upload only (no metadata, no screenshots)
      # #346: the daily Play leg passes android_track=beta; the input was
      # consumed (PLAY_TRACK below) but never declared, so every dispatch
      # died in seconds with HTTP 422 "Unexpected inputs provided".
      android_track:
        description: 'Android: Play upload track when android_content includes an upload (fastlane supply track)'
        required: false
        default: 'internal'
        type: choice
        options:
          - internal # owner/closed testing — manual dispatch default (issue #289 track policy)
          - beta     # external/open testing — the daily Play leg
          - production
      ios_content:
        description: 'iOS: what to deploy'
        required: false
        default: 'none'
        type: choice
        options:
          - none             # skip iOS entirely
          - all              # build + TestFlight + metadata + screenshots
          - metadata_only    # texts/descriptions only (no build, no TestFlight, no screenshots)
          - screenshots_only # screenshots only (no build, no TestFlight, no texts)
          - app_only         # build + TestFlight only (no metadata, no screenshots)

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: write
  id-token: write

# Per-dispatch group (#351): the group is scoped by run_id so NO run can
# cancel another. The old ref-scoped group with cancel-in-progress made
# every fresh dispatch — including the daily watcher's wedge self-heal
# RE-DISPATCH (#344) — cancel whatever build-mobile run was in flight on
# main (a manual dispatch, or the sibling daily leg's child in a
# single-leg run): a cross-run cancellation vector. Every dispatch is now
# independent; the #177 supersede-cancellation is intentionally traded
# away. The daily play/testflight legs dispatch this workflow CONCURRENTLY
# by design (#359 — decoupled from each other): their runs tell apart by
# the run-name correlation (#343), not by serialization, and the single
# self-hosted macOS runner serializes the iOS builds physically.
concurrency:
  group: Build Mobile Apps-${{ github.ref }}-${{ github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  version:
    name: Derive version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Explicit ceiling so the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351) has
    # a real per-job bound instead of GitHub's 360m default. gh-1477: 10m
    # was a time bomb — the full-history fetch outgrew it and cancelled the
    # job mid-fetch (run 38027695551). 20m + the blobless filter below.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1477: this job reads ONLY `git tag` — a full clone transfers
          # every blob ever written and the repo grows daily, so the fetch
          # outgrew the old 10m ceiling (run 38027695551). Blobless keeps
          # full tag/commit metadata without the blobs.
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Derive build version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INPUT="${{ inputs.version }}"
          if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ "$INPUT" = "auto" ]; then
            LATEST=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
              TAG="v0.1.0"
              echo "No previous tag found — starting at $TAG"
            else
              MAJOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\1/')
              MINOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\2/')
              PATCH=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\3/')
              PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
              TAG="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
              echo "Previous tag: $LATEST → auto-increment to $TAG"
            fi
          else
            TAG="$INPUT"
            [[ "$TAG" != v* ]] && TAG="v$TAG"
            echo "Using manual version: $TAG"
          fi
          VERSION_CLEAN="${TAG#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION_CLEAN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  build-android:
    name: Build Android AAB
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351): gradle AAB
    # + bundletool validate historically ~20m, 45m is the slow-day bound.
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # .env is gitignored but declared as a Flutter asset (flutter_dotenv);
      # newer flutter validates assets at build time, so the placeholder must
      # exist BEFORE flutter pub get (issue #368: aot_android_asset_bundle
      # died on "No file or variants found for asset: .env"). Content mirrors
      # the ci.yml/build-macos.yml incantation — bare `touch` is not enough
      # on ubuntu/flutter 3.47.4.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors the iOS GoogleService-Info.plist step: the committed
      # google-services.json is a placeholder (the google-services Gradle
      # plugin hard-fails without the file); overwrite it from the secret
      # when available.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written (package: $(python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json'))['client'][0]['client_info']['android_client_info']['package_name'])"))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      - name: Validate Android secrets
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::error::PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON secret is not set — the Play Developer API service-account JSON key is required"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          if [ -z "$ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS" ]; then echo "::error::ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS secret is not set"; exit 1; fi
          echo "All required Android secrets are present"

      - name: Setup Ruby
        # ubuntu-24.04 runner images ship no Ruby — `bundle: command not
        # found` exit 127 (issue #353). Same setup as store-metadata.yml.
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      # The lane wraps `flutter build appbundle --release`; the upload
      # keystore rides the ANDROID_* env vars (issue #289) and is decoded
      # by app/build.gradle.kts into the (gitignored) build dir — no
      # key.properties dance. ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING makes a
      # secret-less release build fail LOUDLY instead of debug-signing.
      - name: Build Android AAB
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        run: bundle exec fastlane android build_release

      - name: Verify AAB and validate bundle
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          AAB_PATH="flutter_app/build/app/outputs/bundle/storeRelease/app-store-release.aab"
          if [ ! -f "$AAB_PATH" ]; then
            echo "::error::AAB file not found at $AAB_PATH"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "AAB built successfully: $(ls -la $AAB_PATH)"
          # bundletool validate (issue #289 AC3): catches malformed bundles
          # before they ever reach Play's upload pipeline.
          curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o /tmp/bundletool.jar \
            https://github.com/google/bundletool/releases/download/1.17.0/bundletool-all-1.17.0.jar
          java -jar /tmp/bundletool.jar validate --bundle "$AAB_PATH"
          echo "✅ bundletool validate green"
          # 16 KB page-size gate (gh-746, review round 1): re-check every
          # native lib in the PACKAGED bundle — a staging-layout change that
          # silently un-wires the gate fails here instead of at Play upload.
          # The gate lives in its own script so aab-gate-selftest.yml runs
          # the SAME logic against fixture bundles on every PR (gh-798 AC3):
          # AAB layout base/lib/<abi>/*.so, owned named verdict — never an
          # inherited exit code (gh-786).
          bash scripts/verify_aab_native_libs.sh "$AAB_PATH"

      - name: Upload AAB Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: android-aab
          path: flutter_app/build/app/outputs/bundle/storeRelease/app-store-release.aab
          retention-days: 14

  submit-android:
    name: Submit Android to Play
    needs: [build-android]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351): supply
    # upload historically ~5m.
    timeout-minutes: 30
    if: needs.build-android.result == 'success'
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Download AAB artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: android-aab
          path: flutter_app/aab/

      - name: Setup Ruby
        # ubuntu-24.04 runner images ship no Ruby — `bundle: command not
        # found` exit 127 (issue #353). Same setup as store-metadata.yml.
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'

      - name: Install fastlane
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: bundle install

      # Mirrors submit-ios: without the Play service account the upload
      # skips neutrally (the AAB stays on the GitHub release / artifacts).
      # Track policy (issue #289): manual dispatches default to the
      # internal track; the daily Play leg passes beta (external/open
      # testing). PLAY_VALIDATE_ONLY=1 flips the lane into a dry run.
      - name: Upload AAB to Google Play
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the Play upload (the AAB stays on the GitHub release / artifacts)."
            exit 0
          fi
          AAB_PATH="$(find "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/flutter_app/aab" -name '*.aab' -type f | head -1)"
          echo "Uploading $AAB_PATH to the Play '$PLAY_TRACK' track..."
          ANDROID_AAB_PATH="$AAB_PATH" bundle exec fastlane android upload_only

      # Issue #947: android_content=all means the LISTING ships too. The
      # listing lane replaces the whole image set per locale + device type
      # (supply appends, which is how a stale rejected screenshot survived
      # on the live listing) and verifies the committed state via
      # edits.images.list. Runs after the AAB upload so a release train
      # never ships a binary against a stale listing.
      - name: Deploy Play listing (metadata + images)
        if: inputs.android_content == 'all'
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON: ${{ secrets.PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON }}
          PLAY_TRACK: ${{ inputs.android_track }}
          PLAY_DEPLOY_METADATA: 'true'
          PLAY_DEPLOY_IMAGES: 'true'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Play service account not configured — skipping the listing deploy."
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Deploying the Play listing (texts + images)..."
          bundle exec fastlane android play_store

  build-android-apks:
    # Issue #622: the flavor matrix. The AAB job above stays the Play
    # pipeline (store, unchanged); this job builds BOTH release APKs from
    # ONE variable — FLAVOR drives both the gradle --flavor and the
    # FA_FLAVOR dart-define (contract: the pair must never drift). god
    # (applicationId dev.fa1.app.god) is sideload-only and NEVER reaches
    # Play (binding threat model): it ships as an APK attached to the
    # GitHub release. store keeps its AAB for Play and additionally gets
    # an APK for direct installs + the UT-CI-1 size-delta tracking.
    name: Build Android APK (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    needs: version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    if: |
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'none' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != '' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'metadata_only' &&
      github.event.inputs.android_content != 'screenshots_only'
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'
          cache: 'gradle'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      # Same placeholder-.env incantation as build-android (issue #368):
      # .env is a declared Flutter asset and newer flutter validates
      # assets at build time.
      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      # Mirrors build-android, gated to the store flavor: the secret file
      # carries ONLY the dev.fa1.app client, while the god applicationId is
      # dev.fa1.app.god — overwriting it would hard-fail the google-services
      # plugin ("No matching client found for package name
      # 'dev.fa1.app.god'"). god builds with the committed placeholder
      # google-services.json, which carries both clients.
      - name: Write google-services.json (Android)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ "$FLAVOR" != "store" ]; then
            echo "$FLAVOR builds with the committed placeholder google-services.json — the secret file has no dev.fa1.app.god client"
          elif [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/android/app/google-services.json
            echo "google-services.json written"
          else
            echo "GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON_BASE64 not set — building with the committed placeholder google-services.json"
          fi

      # Same release keystore as the AAB job (contract: store and god sign
      # with the SAME release key — only the applicationId differs), same
      # strict-signing posture: no silent debug-signed APKs. No Play
      # service account here — god never touches Play.
      - name: Build flavor APK
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_BASE64 }}
          ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS: ${{ secrets.ANDROID_KEY_ALIAS }}
          ANDROID_STRICT_RELEASE_SIGNING: 'true'
        # ONE variable ($FLAVOR, job-level env from the matrix) feeds BOTH
        # the gradle flavor and the FA_FLAVOR dart-define.
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flutter build apk --release --flavor "$FLAVOR" --dart-define=FA_FLAVOR="$FLAVOR"

      - name: Verify flavor APK
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-$FLAVOR-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          if [ -z "$APK" ]; then
            echo "::error::app-$FLAVOR-release.apk not found under flutter_app/build/app/outputs"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "APK built successfully: $(ls -la "$APK")"

      - name: Store APK size delta vs previous release (UT-CI-1)
        if: matrix.flavor == 'store'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          APK=$(find flutter_app/build/app/outputs -name "app-store-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$APK")
          echo "store APK size: $SIZE bytes"
          # UT-CI-1: track the store APK size delta against the previous
          # release's app-store-release.apk asset. Threshold policy: FAIL
          # the job when the APK grows more than +10% release-over-release
          # (engine/asset bloat must be a conscious, changelogged
          # decision). The enforcement guard stays commented out until the
          # first flavor release exists to diff against — flip it on then.
          PREV_SIZE=$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/releases?per_page=20" \
            --jq '[.[].assets[] | select(.name == "app-store-release.apk")][0].size // empty' 2>/dev/null || true)
          if [ -n "$PREV_SIZE" ]; then
            DELTA=$(python3 -c "print(f'{($SIZE - $PREV_SIZE) / $PREV_SIZE * 100:.1f}')")
            echo "Previous release store APK: $PREV_SIZE bytes — delta: ${DELTA}%"
            {
              echo '### Store APK size (UT-CI-1)'
              echo "- this release: $SIZE bytes"
              echo "- previous release: $PREV_SIZE bytes"
              echo "- delta: ${DELTA}% (fail threshold: +10%)"
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          else
            echo "No previous release store APK found — baseline recorded (this run: $SIZE bytes)."
          fi
          # UT-CI-1 enforcement (enable once a baseline exists):
          # if [ -n "$DELTA" ] && python3 -c "import sys; sys.exit(0 if float('$DELTA') > 10.0 else 1)"; then
          #   echo "::error::store APK grew ${DELTA}% vs the previous release (UT-CI-1 threshold +10%)"
          #   exit 1
          # fi

      - name: Upload APK Artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: android-apk-${{ matrix.flavor }}
          path: flutter_app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-${{ matrix.flavor }}-release.apk
          retention-days: 14

  test-android-emulator:
    # Issue #622 (card DoD): emulator CI job shape for the six mobile
    # channel integration tests (flutter_app/test/integration/
    # mobile_channel_it.dart, tagged `integration`):
    #   IT-flavor-1  — release-manifest audit per flavor
    #   IT-floor-1   — mobile.* availability per tier (issue #19 floor)
    #   IT-observe-1 — hierarchy + screenshot over the channel
    #   IT-gesture-1 — tap / swipe / text injection
    #   IT-shell-1   — Shizuku round-trip (god + opt-in bridge)
    #   IT-consent-1 — consent flow + one-tap disable
    # DISABLED with `if: false` until an emulator runner is provisioned —
    # the hosted pool does not guarantee KVM and a red matrix would gate
    # every release. When provisioned: add
    # `needs: [version, build-android-apks]`, flip the `if` below to
    # `needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success'`, add a
    # download-artifact step for `android-apk-${{ matrix.flavor }}` before
    # the emulator boot, and the job goes green as-is. The same ONE-var
    # rule applies: FLAVOR drives --flavor and FA_FLAVOR.
    name: Android emulator ITs (${{ matrix.flavor }})
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: false
    timeout-minutes: 60
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        flavor: [store, god]
    env:
      FLAVOR: ${{ matrix.flavor }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6.0.1
        with:
          distribution: 'temurin'
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@1a449444c387b1966244ae4d4f8c696479add0b2 # v2
        with:
          channel: 'stable'
          cache: true

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      - name: Install dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Boot emulator
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -e /dev/kvm || { echo "::error::/dev/kvm missing — the provisioned runner must expose KVM"; exit 1; }
          echo no | "$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/avdmanager" create avd \
            -n fa-it --package "system-images;android-34;google_apis;x86_64" --device pixel_5
          "$ANDROID_HOME/emulator/emulator" -avd fa-it \
            -no-window -no-audio -no-boot-anim -no-snapshot -accel on &
          adb wait-for-device
          until [ "$(adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do
            sleep 5
          done
          echo "Emulator booted"

      - name: Install flavor APK

          # job, issue #726) — verify_external_distribution! selects the
          # uploaded build by app version.
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::App Store Connect API key not configured — skipping TestFlight upload (the IPA stays on the GitHub release / artifacts)."
            exit 0
          fi
          IPA_PATH="$(find "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/flutter_app/ipa" -name '*.ipa' -type f | head -1)"
          echo "Uploading $IPA_PATH to TestFlight..."
          IOS_IPA_PATH="$IPA_PATH" bundle exec fastlane ios submit_only

  release-mobile:
    name: Create Mobile GitHub Release
    needs: [version, build-android, build-android-apks, build-ios]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Ceiling for the daily watchers' budget arithmetic (#351).
    timeout-minutes: 15
    if: |
      always() &&
      ((needs.build-android.result == 'success' || needs.build-android.result == 'skipped') ||
       (needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success' || needs.build-android-apks.result == 'skipped')) &&
      (needs.build-ios.result == 'success' || needs.build-ios.result == 'skipped')
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Nothing to release
        # Both platforms picked a no-binary content mode (none /
        # metadata_only / screenshots_only) — nothing was built, so there
        # is nothing to download or release. Record it in the job summary
        # and skip every release step instead of failing on `ls artifacts/`.
        if: needs.build-android.result != 'success' && needs.build-android-apks.result != 'success' && needs.build-ios.result != 'success'
        run: |
          {
            echo '### Nothing to release'
            echo '`android_content` and `ios_content` both selected no binary build (none / metadata_only / screenshots_only) — no release created.'
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

      - name: Checkout repository
        if: needs.build-android.result == 'success' || needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success' || needs.build-ios.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Full history: release_notes.sh falls back to "commits since the
          # previous tag" when the CHANGELOG has no section for this version.
          # gh-1477: blobless — the notes read commit MESSAGES, never
          # historical file blobs.
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Download iOS IPA artifact
        if: needs.build-ios.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: ios-ipa
          path: artifacts/

      - name: Download Android AAB artifact
        if: needs.build-android.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: android-aab
          path: artifacts/

      - name: Download store APK artifact
        if: needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: android-apk-store
          path: artifacts/

      - name: Download god APK artifact
        if: needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: android-apk-god
          path: artifacts/

      - name: List downloaded artifacts
        if: needs.build-android.result == 'success' || needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success' || needs.build-ios.result == 'success'
        run: ls -laR artifacts/

      - name: Create or update GitHub Release
        if: needs.build-android.result == 'success' || needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success' || needs.build-ios.result == 'success'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          AAB=$(find artifacts -name "*.aab" -type f | head -1)
          IPA=$(find artifacts -name "*.ipa" -type f | head -1)
          STORE_APK=$(find artifacts -name "app-store-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          GOD_APK=$(find artifacts -name "app-god-release.apk" -type f | head -1)
          echo "AAB: $AAB"
          echo "IPA: $IPA"
          echo "store APK: $STORE_APK"
          echo "god APK: $GOD_APK"

          ASSETS=()
          [ -n "$AAB" ] && ASSETS+=("$AAB")
          [ -n "$IPA" ] && ASSETS+=("$IPA")
          [ -n "$STORE_APK" ] && ASSETS+=("$STORE_APK")
          [ -n "$GOD_APK" ] && ASSETS+=("$GOD_APK")

          # Notes come from the CHANGELOG section for this version, with a
          # conventional-commit fallback (issue #282: no more filler
          # bodies); the install hints stay as a footer.
          bash scripts/release_notes.sh "$RELEASE_TAG" > release-notes.md || true
          printf '\n## Installation\n- **Android**: Download the AAB and upload to Play Store, or use `flutter install`.\n- **Android god flavor (sideload only)**: install the god APK directly — see https://fa1.dev/android.\n- **iOS**: Download the IPA and upload to TestFlight via Xcode or Transporter.\n- **macOS**: Download the DMG from the macOS build workflow.\n' >> release-notes.md

          # Attach-or-create (issue #282 E3 + review of #294): idempotent
          # against the view->create race - a lost race uploads into the
          # winner's release instead of failing - and the create stamps an
          # ownership marker into the draft body, so the guard step below
          # only ever deletes THIS job's draft, never the macOS leg's
          # mid-upload draft on the same derived tag.
          bash scripts/release_attach_or_create.sh "$RELEASE_TAG" "${ASSETS[@]}"

      # Draft lifecycle invariant (issue #282): the create above uploads
      # assets through a draft — a failed/cancelled run must delete it,
      # never orphan it (the v0.1.190 rot). Ownership-scoped (review of
      # #294): the guard deletes only a draft whose body carries THIS
      # run+job's marker — a sibling leg's draft is never touched.
      - name: Draft lifecycle guard (delete orphaned draft on failure)
        if: >-
          always() && job.status != 'success' &&
          (needs.build-android.result == 'success' || needs.build-android-apks.result == 'success' || needs.build-ios.result == 'success')
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ needs.version.outputs.tag }}
        run: bash scripts/release_draft_guard.sh "$RELEASE_TAG"

# Manual App Store review submission (issue #239 Track 2): submits the iOS
# and/or macOS build of an already-processed TestFlight version straight to
# App Store review. Nothing here builds or uploads a binary — the
# `submit_for_review` lanes pre-flight against App Store Connect and fail
# BEFORE any mutation:
#   - the version must exist (create it via store-metadata.yml first)
#   - a processed TestFlight build must exist for the version
#   - a version already in review = green no-op notice (idempotent re-run)
# `confirm` must repeat `version` exactly (fat-finger guard on an
# irreversible-ish action).
#
# Release-after-approval stays a manual ASC click (owner decision for the
# first month): flipping to automatic release is a one-line repo variable,
# APP_STORE_AUTOMATIC_RELEASE=true (E5).
#
# Secrets: only the existing APP_STORE_CONNECT_* — no new credentials.

name: App Store review submission

run-name: "App Store review (${{ inputs.platforms }}): ${{ inputs.version }}"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'App version to submit (must match a processed TestFlight build, e.g. 1.2.3)'
        required: true
        type: string
      platforms:
        description: 'Platforms to submit'
        required: true
        default: both
        type: choice
        options:
          - ios
          - macos
          - both
      confirm:
        description: 'Type the version string again to confirm'
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  guard:
    name: Fat-finger guard
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Confirm must repeat the version
        run: |
          if [ "${{ inputs.confirm }}" != "${{ inputs.version }}" ]; then
            echo "::error::confirm ('${{ inputs.confirm }}') does not equal version ('${{ inputs.version }}') — aborting before any mutation"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Confirmed: submitting version ${{ inputs.version }} (${{ inputs.platforms }}) for App Store review"

  ios:
    name: Submit iOS for App Store review
    needs: guard
    if: inputs.platforms == 'ios' || inputs.platforms == 'both'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: flutter_app

      - name: Submit for review (pre-flight fails before any mutation)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          APP_STORE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONFIRM: ${{ inputs.confirm }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane ios submit_for_review

  macos:
    name: Submit macOS for App Store review
    needs: guard
    if: inputs.platforms == 'macos' || inputs.platforms == 'both'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: ruby/setup-ruby@14594264cd68ce8a2345dd349bc3d138a4ef85c8 # v1.99.0 (branch head; v1 moves)
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.2'
          bundler-cache: true
          working-directory: flutter_app

      - name: Submit for review (pre-flight fails before any mutation)
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          APP_STORE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          APP_STORE_CONFIRM: ${{ inputs.confirm }}
        run: bundle exec fastlane mac submit_for_review
