name: Build macOS Release (Fa)

# Issue #343: the daily-publish CLI leg and a human can dispatch this
# workflow in the same window; the run-name embeds the input so the
# watcher's displayTitle match (the only distinguisher in the run-list
# API) never adopts someone else's run.
run-name: "build-macos (create_release=${{ inputs.create_release }})"

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Release version (e.g. v0.0.2) or "auto" to increment patch'
        required: false
        default: 'auto'
      create_release:
        description: 'Create GitHub Release'
        required: false
        default: 'true'
        type: choice
        options:
          - 'true'
          - 'false'

# Release builds are never preempted (issue #194 pt 5, same principle as
# ci.yml: main/tag/release runs must not be cancelled mid-flight).
concurrency:
  group: Build macOS Release (Fa)-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

# SEC-08 (#796): minimal default — release-attaching jobs grant
# contents: write in their own job-level blocks.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  version:
    name: Derive version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Explicit ceiling so the daily cli watcher's budget arithmetic (#351)
    # has a real per-job bound instead of GitHub's 360m default. gh-1477:
    # 10m was a time bomb — the full-history fetch outgrew its twin in
    # build-mobile (run 38027695551). 20m + the blobless filter below.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.version.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # gh-1477: this job reads ONLY `git tag` — a full clone transfers
          # every blob ever written and the repo grows daily, so the fetch
          # outgrew the old 10m ceiling (run 38027695551). Blobless keeps
          # full tag/commit metadata without the blobs.
          fetch-depth: 0
          filter: blob:none

      - name: Derive build version
        id: version
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          INPUT="${{ inputs.version }}"
          if [ -z "$INPUT" ] || [ "$INPUT" = "auto" ]; then
            LATEST=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || echo "")
            if [ -z "$LATEST" ]; then
              TAG="v0.0.1"
              echo "No previous tag found — starting at $TAG"
            else
              MAJOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\1/')
              MINOR=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\2/')
              PATCH=$(echo "$LATEST" | sed 's/v\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)\.\([0-9]*\)/\3/')
              PATCH=$((PATCH + 1))
              TAG="v${MAJOR}.${MINOR}.${PATCH}"
              echo "Previous tag: $LATEST → auto-increment to $TAG"
            fi
          else
            TAG="$INPUT"
            [[ "$TAG" != v* ]] && TAG="v$TAG"
            echo "Using manual version: $TAG"
          fi
          VERSION_CLEAN="${TAG#v}"
          echo "version=$VERSION_CLEAN" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "tag=$TAG" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

  build-macos:
    name: Build macOS ${{ matrix.arch }}
    needs: version
    runs-on: [self-hosted, macOS, ARM64]
    # Issue #239: TestFlight submit now waits for Apple processing (bounded,
    # default 90 min) + a ~1-min one-shot appearance probe AFTER the
    # build/notarize work (gh-1041: the blocking distribution wait moved to
    # the deferred store-appearance-check workflow) — the job ceiling must
    # cover the worst case, not just the build.
    timeout-minutes: 150
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        arch: [arm64, x86_64]
    permissions:
      contents: write
    env:
      # Workaround: force .NET (used by the runner) to use SocketsHttpHandler
      # instead of Apple's SSL APIs, avoiding "bad certificate format" errors
      # caused by corporate Zscaler/MDM certificates in the system keychain.
      DOTNET_SYSTEM_NET_HTTP_USESOCKETSHTTPHANDLER: "0"

    steps:
      # ── Prepare persistent local git mirrors ────────────────────────────────
      - name: Update local git mirrors
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          MIRROR_BASE="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror"
          mkdir -p "$MIRROR_BASE"

          update_mirror() {
            local url="$1"
            local mirror="$2"
            local extra_args="${3:-}"
            if [ ! -d "$mirror" ]; then
              echo "Creating mirror: $mirror"
              if [ -n "$extra_args" ]; then
                # --mirror conflicts with --single-branch/--branch; use --bare
                # for branch-specific mirrors (e.g. flutter_code_editor).
                git clone --bare $extra_args "$url" "$mirror"
              else
                git clone --mirror "$url" "$mirror"
              fi
            else
              echo "Updating mirror: $mirror"
              if ! git -C "$mirror" fetch origin 2>/dev/null; then
                echo "Fetch failed — recreating mirror: $mirror"
                rm -rf "$mirror"
                if [ -n "$extra_args" ]; then
                  git clone --bare $extra_args "$url" "$mirror"
                else
                  git clone --mirror "$url" "$mirror"
                fi
              fi
            fi
          }

          update_mirror https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$MIRROR_BASE/flutter_agent_harness.git"

      # ── Checkout ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
      - name: Checkout repository from local mirrors
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail

          MIRROR_BASE="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/mirror"
          MAIN_MIRROR="$MIRROR_BASE/flutter_agent_harness.git"
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          BUILD_CACHE_DIR="$HOME/actions-runner-yoloit/build-cache/macos-$ARCH"

          echo "HOME=$HOME"
          echo "GITHUB_WORKSPACE=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          echo "MAIN_MIRROR=$MAIN_MIRROR"
          echo "ARCH=$ARCH"

          if [ -d "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build/macos" ]; then
            echo "Preserving existing macOS build cache for $ARCH..."
            rm -rf "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR"
            mkdir -p "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR"
            mv "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/build/macos" "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR/"
          fi

          cd /tmp
          rm -rf "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
          mkdir -p "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

          echo "Cloning main repo with mirror reference..."
          git clone --reference "$MAIN_MIRROR" --depth=1 \
            https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness.git "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

          cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"

          if [ -d "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR/macos" ]; then
            echo "Restoring macOS build cache for $ARCH..."
            mkdir -p build
            mv "$BUILD_CACHE_DIR/macos" build/
          fi

      # Persistent pinned SDK (issue #354): same rationale as
      # build-mobile.yml — on a persistent self-hosted runner the
      # flutter-action cache costs a ~1GB untar on setup plus a whole-SDK
      # re-tar POST per job. The composite action pins the SDK at
      # ~/actions-runner-yoloit/flutter-sdk (.fah-version marker):
      # subsecond reuse, one download per pin bump, no POST step.
      # Still a pinned 3.47.x install instead of the runner's
      # pre-installed SDK — the candidate-path loop picked up a stale
      # 3.44.4 at ~/.local/flutter, which broke `flutter pub get` the
      # moment the repo floor moved to >=3.47.0 (daily-publish #260/#261).
      - name: Setup Flutter environment
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-flutter-selfhosted
        with:
          # EXACT patch pin (#1431): this leg builds + gates fa-extension.zip
          # against scripts/size_budget/fa-extension.tsv — a wildcard pin
          # re-resolves a new engine build on every 3.47.x patch and moves
          # the canvaskit/skwasm rev-hash dir the gate tracks. Bump
          # consciously, with any floor reseed in the same PR.
          flutter-version: '3.47.7'

      - name: Setup host toolchains
        run: |
          echo "/opt/homebrew/opt/ruby/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          echo "/opt/homebrew/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          flutter --version
          dart --version

      # gh-1275 AC3: fail fast before any build minute is spent — the full
      # gate rationale lives in .github/actions/assert-builtin-skills.
      - uses: ./.github/actions/assert-builtin-skills

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: |
          if command -v rustup &> /dev/null; then
            echo "Rust already installed"
            rustup show
          else
            echo "Installing Rust..."
            curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y
            source "$HOME/.cargo/env"
          fi
          echo "$HOME/.cargo/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH
          rustup --version
          cargo --version

      - name: Create placeholder .env asset
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cat > .env << 'EOF'
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY=
          MODEL_ID=
          BASE_URL=
          HUGGINGFACE_TOKEN=
          EOF

      # The plist is gitignored, so the fresh CI checkout has none and the
      # native Firebase SDK logs I-COR000012/0008 at startup. Inject it from
      # a secret when available (same dev.fa1.app registration as
      # firebase_options.dart).
      - name: Write GoogleService-Info.plist (macOS)
        env:
          GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64" | base64 --decode > flutter_app/macos/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist
            echo "GoogleService-Info.plist written (bundle: $(plutil -extract BUNDLE_ID raw flutter_app/macos/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist))"
          else
            echo "⚠️ GOOGLE_SERVICE_INFO_PLIST_BASE64 not set — building without the native Firebase plist"
          fi

      - name: Install Flutter dependencies
        uses: ./.github/actions/flutter-pub-get

      - name: Dependency versions
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          echo "=== Dependency versions ==="
          flutter pub deps --style=compact

      # flutter_gemma ≥1.5.5 no longer downloads the Apple LiteRT-LM companion
      # dylibs from its hook (they are bundled via the Podfile phase), so a
      # fresh runner has nothing at ~/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma and the
      # Runner script phase fails with "Could not find macOS companion
      # dylibs". Seed the cache from the upstream native release (pinned,
      # sha256-verified).
      - name: Ensure flutter_gemma macOS companion dylibs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GEMMA_CACHE="$HOME/Library/Caches/flutter_gemma/native/macos_arm64"
          if [ -f "$GEMMA_CACHE/libGemmaModelConstraintProvider.dylib" ]; then
            echo "companion dylibs already cached"
          else
            echo "seeding companion dylibs from flutter_gemma native-v0.16.0"
            mkdir -p "$GEMMA_CACHE"
            # --retry alone skips transient mid-transfer resets (curl 56);
            # --retry-all-errors retries them (sha256 below guards corruption)
            curl -L --retry 3 --retry-all-errors --retry-delay 10 --max-time 600 \
              -o /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz \
              https://github.com/DenisovAV/flutter_gemma/releases/download/native-v0.16.0/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz
            echo "c597554a7a5cdf099658227099a54ef4916c5802b9182757e656e1788f9426b6  /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            tar xzf /tmp/litertlm-macos_arm64.tar.gz -C "$GEMMA_CACHE"
          fi
          ls -la "$GEMMA_CACHE"

      # The workspace is re-cloned every run, which wipes Pods/ and forces a
      # full pod install (~4 min with Firebase). Cache it keyed by the
      # lockfile; $HOME-level caches (pub-cache, CocoaPods download cache,
      # Ruby gems, Flutter SDK) already persist on the self-hosted runner.
      - name: Cache CocoaPods (macOS)
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: flutter_app/macos/Pods
          key: macos-pods-${{ hashFiles('flutter_app/macos/Podfile.lock') }}

      - name: Generate build info
        working-directory: flutter_app
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
          GIT_BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)
          SUBMODULES=$(git submodule status --recursive | tr '\n' ';')

          mkdir -p lib/core/services
          printf '%s\n' \
            '// Generated build info — CI overwrites this file before compilation.' \
            '// ignore_for_file: constant_identifier_names' \
            '' \
            "const String kBuildGitCommit = '${GIT_COMMIT}';" \
            "const String kBuildGitBranch = '${GIT_BRANCH}';" \
            "const String kBuildSubmodules = '${SUBMODULES}';" \
            > lib/core/services/build_info.dart

          echo "Build info generated:"
          cat lib/core/services/build_info.dart

      - name: Cache vendored WasmRun macOS framework
        uses: actions/cache@55cc8345863c7cc4c66a329aec7e433d2d1c52a9 # v6.1.0
        with:
          path: vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework
          key: wasmrun-xcframework-v0.1.0
      - name: Restore vendored WasmRun macOS framework
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The prebuilt XCFramework is excluded from git. Order of preference:
          # 1) actions/cache hit (per-runner, keyed by the release tag) —
          #    every slot is first-run-warm forever;
          # 2) local working copy on this self-hosted runner;
          # 3) upstream release asset — the curl budget MUST fit the 15-min
          #    step cap WITH CORRECT ARITHMETIC (gh-1149): --retry N is N
          #    retries ON TOP OF the initial attempt, so worst case is
          #    (N+1) × max-time + N × retry-delay. 3 × 240s + 2 × 5s + one
          #    30s connect + unzip ≈ 790s < 900s. The old "3 retries × 240s"
          #    math forgot the initial attempt (975s > 900s → the step
          #    timeout fired mid-retry), and without -C - no 240s attempt
          #    could ever deliver the 92.7MB asset at this link's ~300KB/s
          #    (it needs ~309s) — every attempt died at the cap having
          #    restarted from byte 0.
          LOCAL_SRC="/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/flutter_agent/vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks/WasmRun.xcframework"
          DEST="vendor/wasm_run_flutter/macos/Frameworks"
          mkdir -p "$DEST"
          if [ -f "$DEST/WasmRun.xcframework/Info.plist" ]; then
            echo "Using framework already in place (actions/cache hit or valid leftover)"
          elif [ -d "$LOCAL_SRC" ]; then
            echo "Using local framework: $LOCAL_SRC"
            cp -R "$LOCAL_SRC" "$DEST/"
          else
            echo "No cache, no local copy — downloading from upstream release..."
            # -C - makes each loop attempt RESUME the partial zip (Range
            # requests), so slow links make forward progress; retries live
            # in THIS loop (not curl --retry, which would add extra attempts
            # AND restart+truncate instead of resuming). Budget: 3 × 240s
            # max-time + 2 × 5s sleeps = 730s < the 15-min step cap, leaving
            # connect + unzip + slack (gh-1149).
            # PER-ARCH zip path: both matrix archs run on ONE self-hosted
            # runner (the shared-state race this file already guards with
            # per-arch keychains below) — a shared arch-less /tmp zip would
            # let one job's rm -f unlink the other's in-flight partial, then
            # both curls interleave bytes into one path.
            ZIP="/tmp/WasmRun.xcframework-${{ matrix.arch }}.zip"
            rm -f "$ZIP"
            for attempt in 1 2 3; do
              # --fail: without it curl exits 0 on HTTP 404/5xx and writes
              # the error page into the zip; with it every HTTP error
              # engages this loop's retries and the explicit failure below.
              if curl --fail -L -C - --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 240 \
                -o "$ZIP" \
                https://github.com/juancastillo0/wasm_run/releases/download/wasm_run-v0.1.0/WasmRun.xcframework.zip; then
                break
              fi
              if [ "$attempt" = "3" ]; then
                echo "WasmRun.xcframework download failed after $attempt attempts" >&2
                exit 1
              fi
              echo "download attempt $attempt failed, resuming in 5s..."
              sleep 5
            done
            # The release asset is immutable per tag — pin its digest so a
            # wrong-content-but-valid-zip cannot slip past unzip CRC32 into
            # the permanent wasmrun-xcframework-v0.1.0 cache (same pattern
            # as the litertlm download above).
            echo "aca903d732202bcdf9c8d19fbb8a795c3c930762419f852a5ee228468c548a98  $ZIP" | shasum -a 256 -c -
            unzip -q "$ZIP" -d "$DEST"
          fi
          ls -la "$DEST/WasmRun.xcframework"

      # Per-arch keychain: both matrix archs build on ONE self-hosted
      # runner; a shared build.keychain raced (one job's delete+create
      # emptied it under the other's codesign — errSecInternalComponent /
      # "No certificate found", builds 86).
      - name: Import macOS signing certificate
        id: signing
        env:
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64 }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "⚠️  No signing certificate found — building unsigned (development only)"
            echo "signed=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "✅ Signing certificate found — importing..."
            security delete-keychain build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain 2>/dev/null || true
            security create-keychain -p "$MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security default-keychain -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security unlock-keychain -p "$MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security set-keychain-settings -t 3600 -u build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security list-keychains -d user -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db

            echo "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > certificate.p12
            security import certificate.p12 -k build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain \
              -P "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD" \
              -T /usr/bin/codesign \
              -T /usr/bin/productbuild
            security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -s -k "$MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            echo "signed=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

          if [ -n "$MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64" ]; then
            echo "$MACOS_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_BASE64" | base64 --decode > profile.provisionprofile
            echo "profile_embedded=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

            # Make the profile visible to Xcode manual signing.
            PROFILE_UUID=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract UUID raw -)
            PROFILE_NAME=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract Name raw -)
            PROFILE_TEAM=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract TeamIdentifier.0 raw - 2>/dev/null || true)
            echo "Profile: $PROFILE_NAME / UUID: $PROFILE_UUID / team: $PROFILE_TEAM"
            mkdir -p "$HOME/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning Profiles"
            cp profile.provisionprofile "$HOME/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning Profiles/${PROFILE_UUID}.provisionprofile"
            echo "profile_uuid=$PROFILE_UUID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "profile_team=$PROFILE_TEAM" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "⚠️  No provisioning profile found — TestFlight will warn"
            echo "profile_embedded=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Build macOS release (${{ matrix.arch }})
        env:
          BUILD_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
          BUILD_VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}
          PROFILE_UUID: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_uuid }}
          PROFILE_TEAM: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_team }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          echo "Building for architecture: $ARCH"
          cd flutter_app
          if [ -n "${MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID:-}" ]; then
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual
            if [ -n "${MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID:-}" ]; then
              export FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID"
            elif [ -n "${PROFILE_TEAM:-}" ]; then
              export FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM="$PROFILE_TEAM"
            fi
            if [ -n "${PROFILE_UUID:-}" ]; then
              export FA_PROVISIONING_PROFILE_SPECIFIER="$PROFILE_UUID"
            fi
          else
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="-"
            export FA_CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Automatic
          fi
          FLUTTER_XCODE_ARCHS="$ARCH" flutter build macos --release \
            --build-name=$BUILD_VERSION \
            --build-number=$BUILD_NUMBER
          MAIN_BIN=$(find build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app -name "Fa" -type f | head -1)
          echo "=== Binary architecture verification ==="
          echo "Binary path: $MAIN_BIN"
          file "$MAIN_BIN"
          lipo -info "$MAIN_BIN"
          echo "=== End binary verification ==="
          # The Dart side resolves the wasm_run FFI surface via dlsym on the
          # main executable. If the symbols were dead-stripped or not exported
          # the app boots to a white screen on TestFlight — fail here instead.
          echo "=== wasm_run FFI symbol verification ==="
          # dyld_info reads the exports trie, which survives stripping
          # (nm -gD fails on stripped binaries with "no dynamic symbol table").
          EXPORTS=$(xcrun dyld_info -exports "$MAIN_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true)
          WIRE_COUNT=$(echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -c " _wire_" || true)
          echo "wasm_run wire_* exports in binary: $WIRE_COUNT"
          for SYM in _wire_compile_wasm _store_dart_post_cobject _init_frb_dart_api_dl; do
            if ! echo "$EXPORTS" | grep -qE " ${SYM}\$"; then
              echo "::error::$SYM is not exported from the app binary — wasm_run would crash at runtime (white screen)"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "✅ wasm_run FFI symbols are exported"

      - name: Package as DMG
        id: package
        env:
          SIGNED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.signed }}
          PROFILE_EMBEDDED: ${{ steps.signing.outputs.profile_embedded }}
          MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          ARCH="${{ matrix.arch }}"
          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          DMG_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}.dmg"

          # Size diet (#1096 AC4 + direction 3): drop what no macOS code path
          # can load — before any codesign so the seal covers the shipped
          # tree. Both cuts ride in flutter_assets inside App.framework:
          # 1) assets/wasm (~47 MB) — WASI interpreter modules loaded
          #    exclusively via WasiSandboxShell (env_factory_io.dart routes
          #    desktops to the host Process shell; every rootBundle.load of
          #    assets/wasm lives in the mobile-only shell).
          # 2) packages/js_widget_runtime/test — the pub package's
          #    own test fixture (coach_anny.glb, 5.6 MB); nothing in the app
          #    references that path (the live model, when used, is fetched
          #    by the JS-app catalog, not bundled).
          ASSETS="$APP_PATH/Contents/Frameworks/App.framework/Versions/A/Resources/flutter_assets"
          # Shared prune (scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh — the same call
          # runs on the no-sandbox build and every web packaging surface):
          # fails loudly if the flutter_assets layout drifts instead of
          # silently shipping the fat bundle. Re-enable path (review,
          # #1096): if a desktop WASI/sandbox mode ever ships
          # (WasiSandboxShell on macOS), reseed assets/wasm — until then a
          # desktop wasm load would fail as a missing asset, not a
          # #1224-class "no lazy loader" stub.
          bash scripts/prune_flutter_assets.sh "$ASSETS" \
            assets/wasm packages/js_widget_runtime/test

          rm -f fa-macos-*.dmg tmp-fa.dmg
          rm -rf dmg-staging

          echo "Packaging: $APP_PATH → $DMG_NAME (arch: $ARCH)"

          if [ "$SIGNED" = "true" ] && [ -n "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" ]; then
            echo "Signing .app bundle..."

            RESVG_BIN="$APP_PATH/Contents/Resources/resvg"
            if [ -f "$RESVG_BIN" ]; then
              echo "Stripping extended attributes from resvg..."
              xattr -cr "$RESVG_BIN" 2>/dev/null || true
              echo "Signing resvg binary..."
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$RESVG_BIN"
            fi

            find "$APP_PATH" -type f \( -perm +111 -o -name '*.dylib' \) | while read -r bin; do
              if codesign -dv "$bin" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID"; then
                continue
              fi
              echo "Signing nested binary: $bin"
              codesign --force --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                "$bin" 2>/dev/null || true
            done

            if [ "$PROFILE_EMBEDDED" = "true" ] && [ -f "profile.provisionprofile" ]; then
              echo "Embedding provisioning profile..."
              cp profile.provisionprofile "$APP_PATH/Contents/embedded.provisionprofile"
              APP_ID=$(security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile | plutil -extract Entitlements xml1 -o - - | grep -A 1 'com.apple.application-identifier' | tail -1 | sed 's/.*<string>\(.*\)<\/string>.*/\1/')
              TEAM_ID="${APP_ID%%.*}"
              # Start from Release.entitlements (network client+server, file
              # bookmarks, calendar, contacts, health, homekit, audio input)
              # and inject the provisioning identity keys — do NOT collapse
              # to a sandbox-only dict: the app needs every entitlement the
              # sandbox declares, and dropping them breaks SSO callback
              # servers, file access, and OS-level permission flows in the
              # signed production build.
              cp flutter_app/macos/Runner/Release.entitlements entitlements.plist
              # PlistBuddy handles dotted top-level key names (plutil
              # -insert/-replace treats dots as nested key separators).
              /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :com.apple.application-identifier string $APP_ID" entitlements.plist
              /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Add :com.apple.developer.team-identifier string $TEAM_ID" entitlements.plist
              # The profile may not grant every *capability* the app declares
              # (e.g. homekit needs a separate App ID capability in the
              # Developer Portal). TestFlight rejects capability entitlements
              # the profile doesn't include ('Invalid Code Signing
              # Entitlements', error 90285).
              #
              # Only com.apple.developer.* keys are profile-gated. The
              # com.apple.security.* sandbox entitlements (network, files,
              # personal-information) are NOT in the profile by design — any
              # sandboxed app may declare them — so they must survive.
              #
              # NOTE: `plutil -extract ... -o -` (stdout form) is not
              # supported on every macOS the runner may have; use real temp
              # files so the extraction can't silently produce nothing.
              security cms -D -i profile.provisionprofile -o profile_decoded.plist
              plutil -extract Entitlements json profile_decoded.plist -o profile_ents.json
              for KEY in $(plutil -convert xml1 entitlements.plist -o - | grep -o '<key>[^<]*</key>' | sed 's/<[^>]*>//g'); do
                case "$KEY" in
                  com.apple.application-identifier|com.apple.developer.team-identifier) continue ;;
                  com.apple.developer.*) ;;
                  *) continue ;; # sandbox + misc entitlements are not profile-gated
                esac
                if ! python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('profile_ents.json')); raise SystemExit(0 if '$KEY' in d else 1)"; then
                  echo "Dropping capability not granted by profile: $KEY"
                  /usr/libexec/PlistBuddy -c "Delete :$KEY" entitlements.plist
                fi
              done
              ENTITLEMENTS="entitlements.plist"
            else
              ENTITLEMENTS="flutter_app/macos/Runner/Release.entitlements"
            fi

            codesign_app() {
              codesign --force --deep --sign "$MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID" \
                --options runtime \
                --timestamp \
                --entitlements "$ENTITLEMENTS" \
                "$APP_PATH"
            }

            for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do
              if codesign_app; then
                break
              fi
              if [ "$attempt" = "5" ]; then
                echo "codesign failed after $attempt attempts"
                exit 1
              fi
              sleep_seconds=$((attempt * 30))
              echo "codesign failed, retrying in ${sleep_seconds}s (attempt $attempt/5)..."
              sleep "$sleep_seconds"
            done

            echo "Verifying code signature..."
            codesign -vv --deep --strict "$APP_PATH"
            spctl -a -vv "$APP_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true
          fi

          DMG_STAGING="dmg-staging"
          rm -rf "$DMG_STAGING"
          mkdir "$DMG_STAGING"
          cp -R "$APP_PATH" "$DMG_STAGING/"
          ln -s /Applications "$DMG_STAGING/Applications"

          TMP_DMG="tmp-fa.dmg"
          hdiutil create \
            -volname "Fa $VERSION" \
            -srcfolder "$DMG_STAGING" \
            -ov \
            -format UDRW \
            "$TMP_DMG"

          hdiutil convert "$TMP_DMG" -format UDZO -o "$DMG_NAME"
          rm -f "$TMP_DMG"
          rm -rf "$DMG_STAGING"

          echo "dmg_name=$DMG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          ZIP_NAME="fa-macos-${ARCH}-${VERSION}-mac.zip"
          echo "Packaging ZIP for auto-update: $ZIP_NAME"
          ditto -c -k --sequesterRsrc --keepParent "$APP_PATH" "$ZIP_NAME"
          SHA512=$(openssl dgst -sha512 -binary "$ZIP_NAME" | openssl base64 -A)
          SIZE=$(stat -f%z "$ZIP_NAME")
          MANIFEST_ARCH="$ARCH"
          if [ "$MANIFEST_ARCH" = "x86_64" ]; then
            MANIFEST_ARCH="x64"
          fi
          MANIFEST_NAME="latest-mac-${MANIFEST_ARCH}.yml"
          RELEASE_DATE=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z")
          printf '%s\n' \
            "version: ${VERSION}" \
            "files:" \
            "  - url: ${ZIP_NAME}" \
            "    sha512: ${SHA512}" \
            "    size: ${SIZE}" \
            "    arch: ${MANIFEST_ARCH}" \
            "path: ${ZIP_NAME}" \
            "sha512: ${SHA512}" \
            "releaseDate: '${RELEASE_DATE}'" \
            > "$MANIFEST_NAME"
          echo "zip_name=$ZIP_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "manifest_name=$MANIFEST_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "baseline_arch=$MANIFEST_ARCH" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      # AC1 (#1096): per-entry uncompressed size table + +5% budget gate on
      # the shipped mac zip (auto-update channel). arm64 baseline is
      # committed, reseeded onto the post-cut shape (#1096 size diet: no
      # wasm_run_flutter.framework, no flutter_assets/assets/wasm, no
      # js_widget_runtime test assets — regrowth of any of those fails as
      # a NEW line > 5% of TOTAL); unknown archs FAIL — never self-seed
      # green.
      - name: Size manifest + budget gate (mac zip)
        run: |
          case "${{ steps.package.outputs.baseline_arch }}" in
            arm64|x64) ;;
            *) echo "::error::mac arch '${{ steps.package.outputs.baseline_arch }}' has no size baseline mapping — add scripts/size_budget/fa-macos-<arch>.tsv and extend this whitelist" >&2; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          python3 scripts/size_manifest.py check "${{ steps.package.outputs.zip_name }}" \
            --baseline "scripts/size_budget/fa-macos-${{ steps.package.outputs.baseline_arch }}.tsv" --init-if-missing

      # A self-seeded baseline (e.g. first x86_64 release) lands only in
      # this job's ephemeral workspace — upload it so it can be fetched
      # and committed to arm that arch's gate (same as pages.yml).
      - name: Upload seeded size baselines (#1096 ratchet)
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: size-baselines-macos
          path: scripts/size_budget/*.tsv
          if-no-files-found: ignore

      - name: Package TestFlight PKG (arm64)
        if: matrix.arch == 'arm64'
        id: testflight_pkg
        env:
          MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64 }}
          MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_PASSWORD }}
          MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID }}
          MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::Mac Installer Distribution cert not configured — skipping TestFlight PKG (the DMG path is unaffected)."
            exit 0
          fi
          # The installer cert goes into the same build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain (it exists
          # from the signing step when SIGNED=true; create it otherwise).
          KEYCHAIN_PASS="${MACOS_KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD:-}"
          if ! security list-keychains | grep -q build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain; then
            # create-keychain fails with "already exists" when the keychain
            # exists but is not in the search list (grep above missed it) —
            # tolerate that and just add it to the search list.
            security create-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASS" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain || true
            security default-keychain -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASS" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
            security list-keychains -d user -s build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain ~/Library/Keychains/login.keychain-db
          fi
          echo "$MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_BASE64" | base64 --decode > installer.p12
          security import installer.p12 -k build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain \
            -P "$MACOS_INSTALLER_P12_PASSWORD" \
            -T /usr/bin/productbuild -T /usr/bin/xcodebuild
          security set-key-partition-list -S apple-tool:,apple: -s -k "$KEYCHAIN_PASS" build-${{ matrix.arch }}.keychain
          rm -f installer.p12

          APP_PATH="flutter_app/build/macos/Build/Products/Release/Fa.app"
          PKG_NAME="fa-macos-arm64-${VERSION}.pkg"
          echo "Building TestFlight package: $APP_PATH → $PKG_NAME"
          productbuild --component "$APP_PATH" /Applications "$PKG_NAME" \
            --sign "$MACOS_INSTALLER_CERT_ID"
          echo "pkg_name=$PKG_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Notarize DMG
        if: steps.signing.outputs.signed == 'true'
        env:
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}
          MACOS_NOTARIZE_APP_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_APP_PASSWORD }}
          DMG_NAME: ${{ steps.package.outputs.dmg_name }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID" ]; then
            echo "⚠️  Notarization secrets not set — skipping notarization"
            exit 0
          fi
          echo "Submitting for notarization..."
          xcrun notarytool submit "$DMG_NAME" \
            --apple-id "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_APPLE_ID" \
            --team-id "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID" \
            --password "$MACOS_NOTARIZE_APP_PASSWORD" \
            --wait
          xcrun stapler staple "$DMG_NAME"
          echo "✅ Notarization complete"

      - name: Submit PKG to TestFlight
        if: steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name != ''
        working-directory: flutter_app
        env:
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID }}
          APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT: ${{ secrets.APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT }}
          MACOS_PKG_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/${{ steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name }}
          # External TestFlight distribution (issue #239): lanes fail
          # loudly when these are unset — set them once as repo variables.
          TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP: ${{ vars.TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP }}
          BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL: ${{ vars.BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL }}
          BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL: ${{ vars.BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL }}
          BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE: ${{ vars.BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT:-}" ]; then
            echo "::notice::App Store Connect API key not configured — skipping TestFlight upload (the PKG stays in artifacts)."
            exit 0
          fi
          bundle install
          bundle exec fastlane mac submit_only

      - name: Upload TestFlight PKG artifact
        if: steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7
        with:
          name: fa-macos-testflight-pkg
          path: ${{ steps.testflight_pkg.outputs.pkg_name }}
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Upload macOS artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: Fa-macos-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: |
            ${{ steps.package.outputs.dmg_name }}
            ${{ steps.package.outputs.zip_name }}
            ${{ steps.package.outputs.manifest_name }}
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Build and package no-sandbox release
        id: package_nosandbox
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.version.outputs.version }}
          ARCH: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          FA_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.MACOS_CERTIFICATE_ID }}
          FA_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM: ${{ secrets.MACOS_NOTARIZE_TEAM_ID }}

# Fastfile for the Fa app (flutter_app).
#
# TestFlight submit lanes, adapted 1:1 from learn.ai's deploy setup: builds
# happen in the CI workflows (flutter build ipa / flutter build macos), so
# these lanes only upload the produced artifacts with the App Store Connect
# API key from the environment:
#
# The daily's submit_only lanes distribute straight to the EXTERNAL
# TestFlight group (issue #239): the group name and Beta App Review contact
# ride repo variables (TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP, BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_*,
# BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL). release-appstore.yml drives the manual
# submit_for_review lanes (App Store review submission).
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID / APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID /
#   APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT
#
# Android (#289): the build_only/build_release + upload_only lanes follow
# the same split against Google Play; the service-account JSON rides
# PLAY_STORE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON and
# the track rides PLAY_TRACK (internal first, then external beta).
#
# iOS:    IOS_IPA_PATH points at the built .ipa (default: build/ios/*.ipa's
#         conventional location).
# macOS:  MACOS_PKG_PATH points at the signed .pkg (Mac Installer
#         Distribution cert) and MACOS_BUNDLE_ID overrides dev.fa1.app.

require_relative "appstore_preflight"
require_relative "play_listing_sync"
require_relative "play_upload_preflight"
require_relative "version_floor"

def asc_api_key
  app_store_connect_api_key(
    key_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID"],
    issuer_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID"],
    key_content: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"],
    is_key_content_base64: false,
    in_house: false
  )
end

# App Store locale map for the store pipeline: fastlane/metadata folder →
# App Store Connect locale. Golden screenshots live one level below under
# the plain language code (test/goldens/store/<en|ru>/<ios|ipad|mac>).
def store_locale_map
  { "en-US" => "en-US", "ru-RU" => "ru" }
end

# Latest "## [version]" section of store_artefacts/metadata/<lang>/changelog.md.
def store_latest_changelog(lang)
  file_path = File.expand_path("../../store_artefacts/metadata/#{lang}/changelog.md", __dir__)
  return "" unless File.exist?(file_path)
  content = File.read(file_path)
  match = content.match(/## \[.*?\][^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=\n## \[|\z)/m)
  match ? match[1].strip : ""
end

def store_pubspec_version
  pubspec_path = File.expand_path("../pubspec.yaml", __dir__)
  return "1.0.0" unless File.exist?(pubspec_path)
  match = File.read(pubspec_path).match(/version:\s+([0-9.]+)/)
  match ? match[1] : "1.0.0"
end

# ── External TestFlight distribution (issue #239) ─────────────────────────
# A missing repo variable is a LOUD named failure at lane start (AC1) —
# never a fastlane stack trace mid-upload. The variables are set once as
# repo variables and passed through by build-mobile.yml / build-macos.yml.
def require_env!(name, what)
  value = ENV[name].to_s.strip
  UI.user_error!("#{name} is not set — #{what}") if value.empty?
  value
end

def external_testflight_group!
  require_env!("TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP",
               "external TestFlight distribution needs the group name (create the 'External Beta' group in App Store Connect, then set the TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP repo variable)")
end

# Beta App Review contact (AC2): external distribution only flips green
# unattended when the review info is complete. The app is local-first —
# it boots without any account or key, so no demo account is required.
def beta_app_review_info!
  {
    contact_first_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_FIRST_NAME", "Uladzimir"),
    contact_last_name: ENV.fetch("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_LAST_NAME", "Klyshevich"),
    contact_email: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL", "Beta App Review needs a contact email (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_EMAIL repo variable)"),
    contact_phone: require_env!("BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE", "Beta App Review needs a contact phone (set the BETA_REVIEW_CONTACT_PHONE repo variable)"),
    demo_account_required: false,
    notes: "Local-first AI agent app. No account, sign-in or API key is required — the app boots fully on-device with local models, so there is nothing to sign into."
  }
end

def beta_app_feedback_email!
  require_env!("BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL", "external TestFlight testing needs a feedback email (set the BETA_APP_FEEDBACK_EMAIL repo variable)")

# distribute_external requires a "What to Test" changelog — pilot raises in
# non-interactive CI without one. Reuse the store release notes.
def testflight_changelog

  notes.empty? ? "Bug fixes and improvements." : notes
end

# Bounded wait for ASC processing (E1): external distribution needs a
# PROCESSED build — pilot silently SKIPS distribution when the wait is
# skipped. Default 90 min; override with TESTFLIGHT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.
def testflight_wait_timeout
  seconds = ENV["TESTFLIGHT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS"].to_i
  seconds.positive? ? seconds : 5400
end

def asc_token!
  require "spaceship"
  Spaceship::ConnectAPI.token ||= Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.create(
    key_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID"],
    issuer_id: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID"],
    key: ENV["APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_CONTENT"]
  )
end

def asc_app!(bundle_id:)
  require "spaceship"
  app = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::App.find(bundle_id)
  UI.user_error!("App #{bundle_id} not found in App Store Connect") if app.nil?
  app
end

# E3: pilot resolves groups BY NAME and silently skips adding the build when
# the name resolves to nothing — fail loudly instead, pointing at the
# variable. Returns [app, matched_group].
def find_external_testflight_group!(bundle_id:, group:)
  asc_token!
  app = asc_app!(bundle_id: bundle_id)
  found = app.get_beta_groups(includes: nil, limit: 200).select { |g| g.name == group }
  UI.user_error!("TestFlight external group '#{group}' (TESTFLIGHT_EXTERNAL_GROUP) not found in App Store Connect — create it or fix the repo variable. Nothing was uploaded.") if found.empty?

end

# gh-1041 (AC1): appearance is NO LONGER the submit leg's job — ASC
# read-side lag (group membership trailing an already-successful
# distribution, #855: run 36382214186 died in a 900s wait-loop while the
# build was in fact live) must never fail a green `upload_to_testflight`.
# After a successful upload ONE read-only probe runs, purely informational
# and unable to raise: found → ✅ line; not yet → a note pointing at the
# deferred store-appearance-check workflow, which re-checks the store
# 120 min after the legs start and files/updates exactly one stub if the
# version is still absent past the horizon. Leg success = upload success.
def verify_external_distribution!(bundle_id:, group:, app_version:)
  probe = lambda do
    app, beta_group = find_external_testflight_group!(bundle_id: bundle_id, group: group)
    group_build_ids = beta_group.fetch_builds.map(&:id)
    build = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Build.all(
      app_id: app.id,
      includes: "preReleaseVersion,buildBetaDetail",
      processing_states: "VALID",
      sort: "-uploadedDate",
      limit: 100
    ).select { |b| b.app_version == app_version && group_build_ids.include?(b.id) }
     .max_by { |b| b.version.to_i }
    if build
      # fastlane deleted BuildBetaDetail#ready_for_external_testing? but left
      # Build#ready_for_external_testing? calling it — NoMethodError the
      # moment ASC returns buildBetaDetail (issue #362; green runs only saw
      # nil, which short-circuits). Read external_build_state from the beta
      # detail directly: IN_BETA_TESTING/BETA_APPROVED = live, anything else
      # (incl. nil detail) = still waiting for Beta App Review.
      external_state = build.build_beta_detail&.external_build_state
      if external_state == "IN_BETA_TESTING" || external_state == "BETA_APPROVED"
        UI.success("✅ #{app_version} (build #{build.version}) is live to the external group '#{group}' — distributed with zero clicks")
      else
        UI.important("Build #{app_version} (#{build.version}) is in '#{group}' and waiting for Beta App Review — external visibility flips automatically on approval, no clicks needed.")
      end
    else
      UI.important("Build #{app_version} not visible in '#{group}' yet — the submit stays GREEN (gh-1041: store read-side lag is not a failure). The deferred store-appearance-check workflow re-checks ASC 120 min after the daily legs start and files/updates one stub if the version is still absent past the horizon.")
    end
  end
  begin
    probe.call
  rescue StandardError => e
    UI.important("Post-submit appearance probe skipped (#{e.class}: #{e.message.to_s[0, 160]}) — the upload above already succeeded; the deferred store-appearance-check workflow owns appearance verification (gh-1041, #855).")
  end
end

# Read-only ASC facts for one platform → AppstorePreflight decision (AC3:
# every check happens BEFORE any mutation).
def appstore_submission_decision(bundle_id:, platform:, version:, confirm:)
  app = asc_app!(bundle_id: bundle_id)
  app_store_version = app
                      .get_app_store_versions(filter: { platform: platform })
                      .find { |v| v.version_string == version }
  builds = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Build.all(
    app_id: app.id,
    version: version,
    platform: platform,
    processing_states: "PROCESSING,VALID,FAILED,INVALID"

  decision = AppstorePreflight.decide(
    version: version,
    confirm: confirm,
    app_store_version: app_store_version && { "state" => app_store_version.app_store_state },
    builds: builds.map { |b| { "number" => b.version, "state" => b.processing_state } }
  )
  [app, decision]
end

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Auto-release: bump the patch version, update CHANGELOG.md, push straight to
# protected main as the fa-release-bot GitHub App (gh-1172).
#
# Runs in CI on every push to main / the 2h catch-up cron / manual dispatch
# (the `release` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml). The job authenticates via
# actions/create-github-app-token (RELEASE_APP_ID + RELEASE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY);
# the App is the ONLY bypass actor on the main ruleset, so the bump commit
# pushes directly — no release PR, no machine review round-trip, no CI queue
# burn on a chore change. The tag + GitHub Release are still cut from the
# pushed 'chore(release):' commit by scripts/tag_release.sh (the `release-tag`
# job), riding the same App token so the tag-scoped binaries/publish jobs fire.
#
# Dry-run: RELEASE_DRY_RUN=1 (or "true") computes and commits the bump locally,
# logs the exact commit + tag that WOULD land, and skips the push.
#
# Changelog rules:
# - a curated `## Unreleased` section becomes the new version's notes;
# - otherwise notes are generated from commit subjects since the last tag;
# - a fresh empty `## Unreleased` is appended at the end (once — repeated runs
#   must not stack duplicates).
#
# Main-race honesty (E1): the push is fast-forward-only; a main that moved
# during the run rejects it and the retry loop re-computes from the fresh
# origin/main — never a blind push over new commits.
set -euo pipefail

# Commit authorship names the App so release commits are attributable in
# history (auditability contract, gh-1172).
git config user.name "fa-release-bot[bot]"
git config user.email "fa-release-bot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

dry_run=0
case "${RELEASE_DRY_RUN:-0}" in 1|true|yes) dry_run=1 ;; esac

# Coalescing guards: pub.dev rate-limits publishes (~12/day), so releases are
# capped at one per 2h; runs with nothing new since the last tag are skipped.
git fetch origin main --tags --quiet
last_tag=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || true)
if [ -n "$last_tag" ]; then
  pending=$(git rev-list --count "$last_tag..origin/main")
  if [ "$pending" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "Auto-release: nothing new since $last_tag, skipping."
    exit 0
  fi
  tag_age=$(( $(date +%s) - $(git log -1 --format=%ct "$last_tag") ))
  if [ "$tag_age" -lt 7200 ]; then
    echo "Auto-release: coalesced — $last_tag is ${tag_age}s old (<2h); $pending commit(s) pending. Next eligible push or the 2h cron will release them."
    exit 0
  fi
fi

# If the previous bump pushed but its tag hasn't been cut yet (the release-tag
# job is still running its quality gate), wait — tagging the next bump before
# the previous one would mis-tag the range. Keyed on the PUBSPEC VERSION, not
# the head commit subject: a missed release-tag run must not wedge auto-release
# forever, so after 1h the guard lets a fresh bump absorb the untagged one
# instead of blocking.
head_version=$(git show origin/main:pubspec.yaml | sed -n 's/^version: //p')
if [ -n "$head_version" ] && ! git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/v$head_version^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  head_age=$(( $(date +%s) - $(git log -1 --format=%ct origin/main) ))
  if [ "$head_age" -lt 3600 ]; then
    echo "Auto-release: v$head_version pushed but untagged (release-tag job pending, ${head_age}s old) — skipping."
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "Auto-release: v$head_version pushed but untagged for ${head_age}s — release-tag likely wedged; proceeding so the next range absorbs it."
fi


for attempt in 1 2 3; do
  git fetch origin main
  git reset --hard origin/main

  current=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
  # Other workflows (iOS/macOS CI) tag releases without bumping pubspec —
  # when tags raced ahead, bump from the latest tag instead, or every run
  # dies on "tag already exists".
  latest_tag=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || true)
  if [ -n "$latest_tag" ]; then
    tag_version="${latest_tag#v}"
    if [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "$current" "$tag_version" | sort -V | tail -1)" = "$tag_version" ]; then
      current="$tag_version"
    fi
  fi
  IFS='.' read -r major minor patch <<< "$current"
  next="$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))"
  echo "Auto-release: v$current -> v$next (attempt $attempt)"

  last_tag=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | head -1 || true)
  if [ -n "$last_tag" ]; then range="$last_tag..HEAD"; else range="HEAD"; fi
  bullets=$(git log "$range" --pretty='- %s' --no-merges | grep -v '^- chore(release):' || true)
  [ -z "$bullets" ] && bullets="- Maintenance release."

  NEXT="$next" BULLETS="$bullets" python3 - <<'PY'
import os
import re

nxt = os.environ["NEXT"]
bullets = os.environ["BULLETS"].strip()
path = "CHANGELOG.md"
text = open(path, encoding="utf-8").read()
section = f"## {nxt}\n\n{bullets}\n"

m = re.search(r"^## Unreleased[ \t]*$", text, re.M)
if m:
    rest = text[m.end():]
    head = re.search(r"^## ", rest, re.M)
    body = rest[: head.start()] if head else rest
    tail = rest[head.start():] if head else ""
    if body.strip():
        # Curated Unreleased content becomes this release's notes.
        new_section = f"## {nxt}\n" + body.rstrip() + "\n"
    else:
        new_section = section
    text = text[: m.start()] + new_section + ("\n" + tail if tail else "")
else:
    text = text.rstrip() + "\n\n" + section

text = text.rstrip() + "\n"
# Append a fresh empty Unreleased exactly once — repeated runs (or a rerun
# after a raced push) must not stack duplicate sections.
if not re.search(r"^## Unreleased[ \t]*$", text, re.M):
    text += "\n## Unreleased\n"
open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8").write(text)
PY

  # gh-1452: pub.dev server-rejects an upload whose CHANGELOG.md exceeds its
  # hard 262144-byte content cap — v1.0.538 died at `dart publish` AFTER the
  # tag + GitHub release existed. Measure the POST-entry changelog and abort
  # BEFORE the bump commit is authored (its push fires tag_release + the
  # publish job): the approach of the cap must surface pre-tag, not
  # mid-upload. Fix when red: archive the tail to CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md.
  bash scripts/check_changelog_size.sh CHANGELOG.md

  sed -i "s/^version: .*/version: $next/" pubspec.yaml
  # One version everywhere (gh-785): the app pubspec (Android versionName,
  # CFBundleShortVersionString fallback, App Store train) rides the same
  # bump so the ASC-approved floor can never outgrow it again.
  sed -i "s/^version: .*/version: $next+1/" flutter_app/pubspec.yaml

  # gh-1299 NG1: the bump invalidates every lockfile pinning the root
  # package version — flutter_app/pubspec.lock pins `flutter_agent_harness
  # <old> from path ..`, and #1268's repo-wide `pub get --enforce-lockfile`
  # hard-fails on exactly that stale pin (v1.0.515 red all 13 main legs).
  # Regenerate the committed lockfiles and ship the refresh IN the bump
  # commit — a release that leaves the tree --enforce-lockfile-dirty is a
  # failed release.
  if ! ( cd flutter_app && flutter pub get ); then
    echo "::error::flutter pub get failed in flutter_app — aborting the release rather than pushing a bump that leaves pubspec.lock stale (gh-1299 NG1)." >&2
    exit 1
  fi

  git add pubspec.yaml flutter_app/pubspec.yaml CHANGELOG.md flutter_app/pubspec.lock

  git commit -m "chore(release): v$next"

  # No committed lockfile may stay dirty across a release (gh-1299 NG1):
  # anything the refresh above could not regenerate (Podfile.lock needs
  # `pod install` — runs on Linux per AGENTS.md/gh-1296; npm pins need
  # `npm install`) fails the release LOUDLY here — after the commit (the
  # staged refresh must not trip this), before the push. Never a shipped
  # bump that leaves the tree stale.
  # The list comes from the ONE inventory (scripts/check_lockfiles.sh).
  lockfiles=()
  while IFS= read -r f; do lockfiles+=("$f"); done < <(bash scripts/check_lockfiles.sh list)
  # PR #1304 rework threads 1+5: the process substitution above swallows a
  # non-zero exit — a `check_lockfiles.sh list` that failed (bad merge,
  # partial checkout, broken LOCKFILES) would leave `lockfiles` EMPTY and
  # degenerate the status below into an unrestricted whole-tree scan, the
  # gate silently no-oping on the exact incident class it guards (and a
  # hard abort under bash 3.2 + `set -u`). Refuse to release unguarded.
  if [ "${#lockfiles[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then
    echo "::error::lockfile inventory is EMPTY — scripts/check_lockfiles.sh list failed; refusing to release without the dirty-tree gate (gh-1299 NG1)." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  dirty=$(git status --porcelain -- "${lockfiles[@]}")
  if [ -n "$dirty" ]; then
    echo "::error::release aborted — committed lockfile(s) still dirty after the refresh; a release that leaves the tree --enforce-lockfile-dirty is a failed release (gh-1299 NG1):"
    echo "$dirty"
    echo "::error::regenerate them (flutter pub get; pod install --repo-update in flutter_app/ios and flutter_app/macos — runs on Linux per AGENTS.md; npm install for the e2e package-locks), commit, re-run the release."
    exit 1
  fi

  if [ "$dry_run" -eq 1 ]; then
    echo "Auto-release DRY-RUN: would push to main: $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) 'chore(release): v$next'"
    echo "Auto-release DRY-RUN: release-tag job would then cut annotated tag v$next + GitHub Release."
    exit 0
  fi

  # Direct push to protected main as the bypass-listed App. Fast-forward only:
  # a main that moved since `reset --hard` rejects the push and the loop
  # re-computes the bump on the fresh head (E1 — never push over new commits).
  if git push origin HEAD:main; then
    echo "Auto-release: pushed chore(release): v$next to main; release-tag job cuts v$next next."
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "Main push raced, retrying..."
done

echo "Auto-release failed after 3 attempts"
exit 1

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Cut the annotated tag + GitHub Release for the release bump that just landed
# on main (see auto_release.sh). Runs on the 'chore(release):' push to main —
# the `release-tag` job in ci.yml. Idempotent: an existing tag is a no-op.
# The tag is pushed with the fa-release-bot App token (checkout token,
# gh-1172) because GITHUB_TOKEN pushes never trigger the tag-scoped
# binaries/publish jobs.
#
# gh-1192 AC3 — the tag pins the BUMP COMMIT, not moving main: the job's
# checkout can land on a main that advanced in the seconds between the bump
# push and this job starting (v1.0.498 captured the #1178 interloper that
# way), so BUMP_SHA — the push event's frozen head_commit.id — is passed by
# the workflow and validated (exact 'chore(release): v<ver>' subject + matching
# pubspec version) before use. A drifted/absent BUMP_SHA falls back to a
# history search for the bump commit; if neither resolves, the script REFUSES
# to tag rather than tag whatever HEAD points at.
set -euo pipefail

git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

git fetch origin main --tags --quiet
version=$(sed -n 's/^version: //p' pubspec.yaml)
tag="v$version"
if git rev-parse -q --verify "refs/tags/$tag^{commit}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Tag $tag already exists — nothing to do."
  exit 0
fi

# ── Resolve the bump commit (gh-1192 AC3) ──────────────────────────────────
# A candidate qualifies only when its subject is exactly the bump subject AND
# its tree carries the tagged version — the two facts auto_release.sh authors
# into every bump commit. A drifted BUMP_SHA (github.sha can resolve to a
# newer main head) fails those checks and the history search decides instead.
resolve_bump() { # $1 = candidate sha; echoes the validated sha or nothing
  local candidate="$1" subject tree_version
  git cat-file -e "$candidate^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || return 1
  subject=$(git log -1 --format=%s "$candidate")
  tree_version=$(git show "$candidate":pubspec.yaml | sed -n 's/^version: //p')
  if [ "$subject" = "chore(release): v$version" ] && [ "$tree_version" = "$version" ]; then
    echo "$candidate"
  fi
}

bump_sha=""
if [ -n "${BUMP_SHA:-}" ]; then
  bump_sha=$(resolve_bump "$BUMP_SHA" || true)
  if [ -z "$bump_sha" ]; then
    subject=$(git log -1 --format=%s "$BUMP_SHA" 2>/dev/null || echo "<unresolvable>")
    echo "::warning::BUMP_SHA $BUMP_SHA is not the v$version bump (subject: $subject) — falling back to the history search"
  fi
fi
if [ -z "$bump_sha" ]; then
  # Subject-only scan — --grep would also match commit BODIES (a bump revert
  # quotes the old subject), and the newest body match must never shadow the
  # real bump. resolve_bump still validates the winner.
  while read -r candidate subject; do
    [ -n "$candidate" ] || continue
    bump_sha=$(resolve_bump "$candidate" || true)
    [ -z "$bump_sha" ] || break
  done < <(git log --format='%H %s' origin/main | awk '$2 == "chore(release):"')
fi
if [ -z "$bump_sha" ]; then
  echo "::error::cannot resolve the v$version bump commit (no valid BUMP_SHA, no 'chore(release): v$version' commit on origin/main) — refusing to tag a moving HEAD (gh-1192 AC3)"
  exit 1
fi

echo "Tagging $tag at $(git rev-parse --short "$bump_sha") (bump commit pinned — gh-1192 AC3)"
# Detach onto the bump so everything below (release notes, the smoke)
# reads the tree that actually ships, even when the checkout had drifted.
git checkout -q --detach "$bump_sha"

# ── gh-1299 NG2: post-release smoke BEFORE tagging/publishing ─────────────
# The tag fires every tag-scoped binaries/publish job, so this is the last
# gate. #1268 runs the whole of CI on `flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile`
# — assert it exits 0 on the exact tree being tagged (v1.0.515 shipped a
# stale pubspec.lock pin and red all 13 main legs). A release commit that
# cannot resolve its own lockfile is never tagged, never published.
if ! ( cd flutter_app && flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile ); then
  echo "::error::release commit $(git rev-parse --short "$bump_sha") fails 'flutter pub get --enforce-lockfile' — refusing to tag/publish v$version (gh-1299 NG2). Regenerate the lockfile on main first (flutter pub get, commit the refresh)."
  exit 1
fi

git tag -a "$tag" -m "Release $tag" "$bump_sha"
git push origin "$tag"

# GitHub Release so the binaries job can attach assets to it. Notes come from
# the CHANGELOG section written by the bump (issue #282). Bare vX.Y.Z title,
# latest explicit (drafts never carry the badge).
notes=$(bash "$(dirname "$0")/release_notes.sh" "$version") || notes="Release $tag"
gh release create "$tag" \
  --title "$tag" \
  --notes "$notes" \
  --latest \
  --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" || true

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Release-notes generator (issue #282): useful, mechanical notes for every
# release path — no more "Release v$next" filler bodies.
#
# Usage: release_notes.sh <version> [range_start]
#   version     bare X.Y.Z or vX.Y.Z
#   range_start optional git ref for the fallback range (default: the
#               newest tag other than vX.Y.Z itself)
#
# Order of preference:
#   1. the CHANGELOG.md `## <version>` section (curated `## Unreleased`
#      content or generated bullets land there via auto_release.sh);
#   2. conventional commits since the previous tag, grouped
#      Features / Fixes / Maintenance, capped at 50 lines with an
#      "…and N more" line (issue #282 E4);
#   3. no commits since the previous tag (re-tag) -> a clean
#      "No changes" body, never an empty page (issue #282 E5/AC5).
set -euo pipefail

version="${1:?usage: release_notes.sh <version> [range_start]}"
version="${version#v}"
range_start="${2:-}"

# ── 1. CHANGELOG.md section for the version ────────────────────────────────
if [ -f CHANGELOG.md ]; then
  section=$(awk -v ver="$version" '
    BEGIN { esc = ver; gsub(/\./, "\\.", esc) }
    $0 ~ "^## " esc "[[:space:]]*$" { found = 1; next }
    found && /^## / { exit }
    found { print }
  ' CHANGELOG.md)
  if [ -n "$(printf '%s' "$section" | tr -d '[:space:]')" ]; then
    printf '%s\n' "$section"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

# ── 2. conventional-commit fallback ────────────────────────────────────────
if [ -z "$range_start" ]; then
  range_start=$(git tag --sort=-v:refname 2>/dev/null \
    | grep -E '^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' | grep -v -x "v$version" | head -1 || true)
fi

range="HEAD"
[ -n "$range_start" ] && range="$range_start..HEAD"
# The release-bump commit itself is noise in its own release notes.
commits=$(git log "$range" --pretty='%s' --no-merges 2>/dev/null \
  | grep -v '^chore(release):' || true)

if [ -z "$commits" ]; then
  # ── 3. re-tag: nothing changed since the previous release ───────────────
  echo "No changes since ${range_start:-the previous release}."
  exit 0
fi

cap="${RELEASE_NOTES_MAX:-50}"
feats=""; fixes=""; chores=""
shown=0
overflow=0
while IFS= read -r subject; do
  [ -n "$subject" ] || continue
  if [ "$shown" -ge "$cap" ]; then
    overflow=$((overflow + 1))
    continue
  fi
  shown=$((shown + 1))
  case "$subject" in
    feat:*|feat\(*) feats="$feats- $subject
" ;;
    fix:*|fix\(*)  fixes="$fixes- $subject
" ;;
    *)             chores="$chores- $subject
" ;;
  esac
done <<< "$commits"

echo "## What's changed"
echo
[ -n "$feats" ]  && printf '### Features\n%s\n' "$feats"
[ -n "$fixes" ]  && printf '### Fixes\n%s\n' "$fixes"
[ -n "$chores" ] && printf '### Maintenance\n%s\n' "$chores"
[ "$overflow" -gt 0 ] && printf '…and %d more\n' "$overflow"
exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# CHANGELOG size guard (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds its hard content cap — `Message from server:
# CHANGELOG.md exceeds the maximum content length (262144 bytes)`. v1.0.538
# died at `dart pub publish` AFTER the tag + GitHub release existed, so the
# version never reached pub.dev. The changelog is append-only by convention
# and the auto-release grows it near-daily; nothing bounded it before this
# guard.
#
# Callers (keep both wired — test/changelog_cap_guard_test.dart asserts the
# wiring):
#   - scripts/auto_release.sh   — BEFORE the bump commit/tag (pre-tag
#     fast-fail: the push is what fires tag_release + the publish job);
#   - .github/workflows/ci.yml `publish` job gate — BEFORE staging/upload
#     (the server reject is the worst possible discovery point).
#
# Usage: check_changelog_size.sh [file] [cap_bytes]
#   file  defaults to CHANGELOG.md (the file pub packs);
#   cap   defaults to 262144 (the pub.dev cap) — strict less-than; the
#         override exists for tests.
#
# Exit 0 = under the cap. Exit 1 = missing file or size >= cap, with a
# ::error:: annotation naming the fix (archive the tail).
set -euo pipefail

file="${1:-CHANGELOG.md}"
cap="${2:-262144}"

if [ ! -f "$file" ]; then
  echo "::error::check_changelog_size.sh: $file does not exist — a release without a changelog is a broken release (gh-1452)."
  exit 1
fi

size=$(wc -c < "$file")
if [ "$size" -ge "$cap" ]; then
  echo "::error::$file is $size bytes — pub.dev rejects uploads at/over the ${cap}-byte content cap (gh-1452: v1.0.538 died mid-upload). Archive older entries to CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (keep ~30 recent versions inline) and re-run the release."
  exit 1
fi
echo "$file: $size bytes < $cap-byte cap — ok"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Stage the publishable package into a target directory (issue #597).
#
# `dart publish` packs everything under the repo root that isn't
# gitignored — and the root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the
# pub package (flutter_app with its 57 MB wasm toolchain, yoclip media,
# browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs, packages/*). That
# blew the archive past pub.dev's hard 100 MB cap (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB).
#
# The staged copy carries the package surface (~32 MB) plus the two PATH
# dev-dependencies (packages/fa_llm_mock, vendored vendor/xterm —
# accepted by pub.dev since v0.1.369). pubspec_overrides.yaml (the
# local-only dart_tui vendor pin, "never ships to pub.dev" by its own
# comment) must NOT enter the stage: version solving would re-pin the
# path dep and fail (the v0.1.407 failure, exit 66).
#
# Usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>
# Exits non-zero (with ::error) when the staged tree exceeds the guard.
# The repo root hosts sub-projects that are NOT part of the pub package
# (flutter_app, yoclip, browser_ext, office_addin, vendored forks, docs)
# — `dart publish` packs everything under the root that isn't gitignored
# (v0.1.406: 100.4 MB, over pub.dev's hard cap). Stage the package
# surface instead. PATH dev-deps of the core pubspec must resolve inside
# the stage (#584, `dart pub get` exit 66 on v0.1.407): their subtrees
# are included BEFORE the parent excludes, and the parent excludes are
# child-scoped (vendor/*) — excluding the parent dir itself would prune
# the subtree before the includes are ever consulted.
# pubspec_overrides.yaml is the workspace-only dart_tui pin (never
# published, see its header); shipped into the stage it re-dangles
# dart_tui onto the excluded vendor dir.
set -euo pipefail

target="${1:?usage: stage_publish_package.sh <target-dir>}"
repo_root="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"

mkdir -p "$target"
# Root-scoped excludes are ANCHORED: rsync matches an unanchored name
# against the basename at ANY depth — `memory` also pruned lib/src/memory/,
# shipping v0.1.411 with broken memory imports (issue #613). build/ and
# .dart_tool stay unanchored: build artifacts may appear at any depth and
# never belong in the stage.
# gh-1452: /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md (the lossless trimmed tail of CHANGELOG.md)
# has no consumer in the pub package — GitHub carries the history. It is
# excluded below; must mirror /CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md in .pubignore (guarded
# by test/publish_staging_test.dart).
rsync -a "$repo_root"/ "$target"/ \
  --include 'vendor/xterm/' --include 'vendor/xterm/**' \
  --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/' --include 'packages/fa_llm_mock/**' \
  --exclude '/.git' --exclude '/.github' --exclude '/.worktrees' \
  --exclude '/flutter_app' --exclude '/browser_ext' \
  --exclude '/office_addin' --exclude '/yoclip' \
  --exclude 'vendor/*' --exclude '/docs' --exclude '/fa-local' \
  --exclude 'packages/*' \
  --exclude '/pubspec_overrides.yaml' \
  --exclude '/CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md' \
  --exclude '.dart_tool' --exclude 'build' \
  --exclude '/memory' --exclude '/.trash' --exclude '/coverage'

size=$(du -sm "$target" | cut -f1)
echo "staged package: ${size} MB"
if [ "$size" -gt 90 ]; then
  echo "::error::staged package is ${size} MB (>90) — pub.dev caps uploads at 100 MB. Trim the staging excludes."
  exit 1
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# install_local.sh — build the Fa CLI from source and install it locally to ~/.local/bin.
#
# Run from the repo root:
#   sh install_local.sh

set -euo pipefail

REPO_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
BUNDLE_DIR="$REPO_ROOT/fa-local/bundle"
INSTALL_DIR="${INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}"

mkdir -p "$INSTALL_DIR/lib"

cd "$REPO_ROOT"

echo "→ Building Fa CLI bundle..."
dart pub get >/dev/null 2>&1 || dart pub get
dart build cli --target=bin/fah.dart --output=fa-local

VERSION="$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')"
echo "$VERSION" > "$BUNDLE_DIR/version.txt"
echo "→ Built fa v$VERSION"

echo "→ Installing to $INSTALL_DIR..."
cp "$BUNDLE_DIR/bin/fah" "$INSTALL_DIR/fa"
chmod +x "$INSTALL_DIR/fa"
# macOS ARM kills unsigned native executables; ad-hoc sign so the copied
# binary is allowed to run from ~/.local/bin.
if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ] && command -v codesign >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  codesign -s - -f "$INSTALL_DIR/fa" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi
cp "$BUNDLE_DIR/version.txt" "$INSTALL_DIR/version.txt"
if [ -d "$BUNDLE_DIR/lib" ]; then
  cp -R "$BUNDLE_DIR/lib/"* "$INSTALL_DIR/lib/" 2>/dev/null || true
fi

echo "→ Installed $INSTALL_DIR/fa"

if ! command -v fa >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "⚠  $INSTALL_DIR is not on your PATH. Add this to your shell rc:"
  echo "   export PATH=\"\$PATH:$INSTALL_DIR\""
else
  INSTALLED_VERSION="$(fa --version)"
  echo "✔  $INSTALLED_VERSION is on PATH"
fi
